The master universe is organized as six vast concentric elliptical space levels revolving around the eternal nucleus of Paradise and Havona. Of these, the domain combining the innermost central universe (Havona) and the seven superuniverses outside it is called the **grand universe**, and the remaining four space levels lying beyond the physical limits of this grand universe are the outer space universes.
From the inside outward, they are vastly arranged in the following order:
First Outer Space Level
Second Outer Space Level
Third Outer Space Level
Fourth and Outermost Space Level

2. The Physical Scale of Space and the Quiet Zones
Between the boundary of the grand universe and the outer space universes, a physical distance is established as a buffer for effectively separating and adjusting energies.
The zone of relatively quiet space (quiet zone): Between the outer border of the seven superuniverses, now organized and inhabited, and the first outer space level lies a quiet zone of space in which there is no cosmic dust or cosmic fog (star dust) whatever. The average width of this buffer zone is no less than about 400,000 light-years.
The thickness of the first outer space level: Beginning at about 500,000 light-years from the boundary of the grand universe, the zone of energy activity of the first outer space level starts, and the volume and breadth of this level itself reach the enormous scale of more than 25,000,000 light-years.
The distance of the second outer space level: The physicists of Uversa have detected evidences of early force manifestations, as the second outer space level begins to be materially organized, in distant space more than 50,000,000 light-years beyond the outermost limits of the first outer space level.
Because of this depth of cosmic space, many of the distant galaxies that the astronomers of Urantia are observing with their telescopes are actually galaxies moving along with the outer border of the superuniverse of Orvonton, and when telescope technology is developed to the utmost, they will witness with wonder at least 375,000,000 new galaxies now being formed in outer space beyond.

3. Alternating Directions of Rotation and Universe Dynamics (Alternating Rotations)
That the mighty forces and materials of the master universe circle in fixed orbits instead of escaping forever in straight lines is due to the almighty grasp of Paradise gravity. To maximize the dynamic stability of the master universe, the galaxies of adjacent space levels are designed to rotate in opposite directions.
The circuits of Havona: The inner worlds of the central universe follow a clockwise procession. (The enormous dark gravity bodies that separate the central universe swirl with the inner belt counterclockwise and the outer belt clockwise) [14:1.3].
The seven superuniverses: They revolve counterclockwise around Paradise.
The first outer space level: The galaxies of the first level beyond the boundary of the grand universe again revolve clockwise.
The second outer space level: Outside the first level, they again revolve counterclockwise.
The third outer space level: The star observers of Uversa are detecting evidences of rotational movement in this region that is again beginning to show a clockwise character.
This structure, in which clockwise and counterclockwise flows appear alternately, prevents the gravitational collapse and explosive dispersion that could result if the galaxies of the universes were all swept in one direction, and it acts as a powerful physical gravity-stabilizing brake (an antigravity influence) that retards dangerous acceleration.

4. The Present State and the Materializing Work of the Master Force Organizers (Current Physical Status)
A thoroughly nonspiritual material state: The energies and materials now being massively accumulated in outer space are still at a wholly nonspiritual stage. Therefore no response to the spirit-gravity circuit appears at all.
The detection of mind ministry: However, the response to the intellectual gravity (mind gravity) of the Infinite Spirit appears in these outer space regions at a level of about 85 percent, which suggests that, apart from any spiritual attunement, intelligent force organizers are directing the evolution of the physical universe.
The ministry of the master force organizers: At present the power directors of the seven superuniverses have nothing to do with these distant space levels, and administratively they lie outside the rule of the superuniverse governments. Instead, the Master Force Organizers sent out from Paradise are actively leading the work of materialization, using the primordial force and space potency of the Unqualified Absolute to form vast gaseous nebulae and transform them into physical energies.
The absence of inhabitants and administrators: As yet, no mortal humans, angels, or any spiritual creatures inhabit the region of the nebulae and suns of these outer space levels.

5. The Future of the Outer Space Universes and the Destiny of the Finaliters (Future Destiny)
At present it is no more than a quiet sea of gases and suns, without life or personality, but the physical mobilization of this vast space is in accordance with the highly intelligent plans of the universe architects.
This stage will become the foundation for the perfect revelation of the almighty sovereignty and spiritual personality of God the Supreme, who will in the future be fully actualized experientially.
Furthermore, the Corps of the Finality, assembled over long ages after completing their ascension training on Paradise, are expected to be sent to these space levels as eternal administrators and leaders. Human finaliters, who began with the lowest minds of animal origin and, eternally united with the Adjuster (the spirit of the Universal Father), have attained perfect divinity, will act as incomparable rulers of these new outer universes, possessed of the deepest sympathy and wisdom.

q066.question: Please tell me in detail about the seven mansion worlds.
q066.answer:
Here is a summary of the mansion worlds of The Urantia Book: their physical location, composition, what is learned on each world, the personalities involved, their importance, and so on.

1. Physical Location
There exists a group of fifty-seven architectural spheres revolving around Jerusem, the administrative headquarters of the local system of Satania [45:0.1]. Of these, the seven satellites surrounding transition culture world number one (the finaliter world) are the seven mansion worlds at which mortals arrive after death [15:7.5, 45:1.2, 47:0.1].

2. Physical and Morontia Composition and Structure
Architectural spheres: The mansion worlds are not planets evolved from natural nebulae but artificial spheres specially designed and made to order by the universe power centers and the physical controllers [15:7.1, 41:1.3]. Therefore they are independent of variations in solar temperature and of planetary upheavals, and they are supplied with constant heating and uniform light [41:1.3, 45:0.3, 46:1.3].
Structure of elements and energy: In addition to the one hundred chemical elements found on the evolutionary planets, they have a dual physical structure in which one hundred distinctive forms of morontia energy-material are superimposed [48:1.3].
Atmosphere and life phenomena: They have a three-gas atmosphere containing a special morontia gas suited to the breathing of morontia life forms [46:2.3]. There is also cultivated a harmonious and beautiful morontia life world of plants and animals in which there is no predation, fear, or survival of the strongest [43:6.5, 46:2.5].
Resurrection halls: On each mansion world the resurrection halls, where sleeping mortals regain consciousness and are reassembled in morontia form, are located in the center [112:5.16, 47:3.2, 47:3.5].
Sea of glass: A vast sea of glass made of crystal has been formed so that the transport seraphim may land safely and so that the reflectivity broadcasts of the superuniverse may be received [46:2.9, 47:4.3, 47:10.2].

3. Curriculum and Tasks on Each World (What Is Learned in Each World)
The pilgrims of time must pass through the seven mansion worlds one by one, completing their tasks of intellectual, morontial, and spiritual development [26:3.2, 47:3.10].

The first mansion world: After resurrection the ascender acquires the morontia self [47:3.5] and concentrates chiefly on correcting and healing the biological, environmental, and spiritual deficiencies and the imperfect inheritance experienced in the earthly life [47:3.8]. Those who did not fulfill the experience of parenthood on earth make plans to have this deficiency made up in the nurseries of the finaliter world or in the homes of the Material Sons on Jerusem [45:6.8, 47:1.4]. Here they are first introduced to "mota," the foundation of morontia philosophy [48:7.1].

The second mansion world: Social organization and community take on a formal scale, and the ascenders enter into serious social activity [47:4.1]. They receive training to resolve completely the intellectual conflicts of earth and to correct mental disharmonies [47:4.8]. They begin in earnest to learn how to master the meanings of mota [47:4.8].

The third mansion world: This is where the official headquarters of the Mansion World Teachers is located [47:5.1], and truly progressive morontia culture begins [47:5.3]. The ascenders come to understand the correlation of morontia mota with human reason and logic and their philosophic harmony [47:5.3], and they acquire real metaphysical insight into cosmic meanings and interrelationships [47:5.3].

The fourth mansion world: This is the stage at which the ascending mortal is first introduced to a pure socialization and cosmic co-operation that do not presuppose selfish motives or personal conquest [47:6.3]. The ascenders co-operate in a new cosmic social order based on the sympathy of mutual appreciation and unselfish love [47:6.3], and they come to understand deeply the universe news broadcasts and the broad culture of the universe [47:6.2].

The fifth mansion world: This is the glorious time when "cosmic consciousness" is truly born in the human mind [47:7.5]. Becoming universe minded, their horizons widen without end; they fully master Nebadonian, the language of the local universe, and devote themselves to acquiring the language of the superuniverse (Uversa) [47:7.2, 47:7.5]. Voluntary study, unselfish service, and spontaneous worship become established as the way of life [47:7.5].

The sixth mansion world: This is the shining stage at which the "final fusion with the Thought Adjuster," which seals forever the immortality and identity of the ascending human, is at last officially accomplished and confirmed [47:8.3, 47:8.4]. Immediately upon fusion the ascender receives a new universe name and, through forty days of spiritual retirement, plans and chooses for himself the course of ascent leading on to Paradise [47:8.5]. In addition, the ascenders receive their first universe lessons in the techniques of grand universe administration [47:8.2].

The seventh mansion world: This is the place of purification where the last remnants of the "⟦Q 47:9.1⟧mark of the beast⟦/Q⟧" (the coarse traces of animal origin, unfit heredity, and the defects of unfavorable environment) are completely eradicated and cleansed away [47:9.1]. Having until now advanced as individuals, the ascenders at last form into groups and prepare for group (class) advancement in order to depart as citizens of Jerusem [47:9.3, 47:9.4]. They are trained in the ability to worship the invisible Universal Father more spiritually and graduate as mature morontia beings [47:9.2, 47:9.5].

4. Personalities and Helpers
While the pilgrims of time are being transformed from material human beings into morontia beings, precisely co-ordinated celestial helpers reside on the mansion worlds [47:10.7, 48:0.3].
Melchizedeks: The supreme supervisors who have general charge of and govern the mansion worlds, the educational system, and the probationary nurseries for children [35:4.1, 47:0.4, 47:2.1].
Morontia Supervisors: They regulate the routine administration of each mansion world and the management of morontia energies [47:0.4, 48:2.18].
Morontia Companions: Official and friendly associates who stay by the ascenders like sisters, they are the ascenders' closest partners, helping with friendship, recreation, travel, language translation, and social integration [47:3.11, 47:3.12, 48:3.8, 48:3.11].
Mansion World Teachers: Composed of glorified senior cherubim and sanobim, they devote themselves as patient and effective teachers suited to the stages of the mortals' morontia development [47:5.1, 48:5.1, 48:5.5].
Transition ministers (seraphim): The sixth order of seraphim, they directly regulate the transition from matter to spirit. They work in seven specialized corps: seraphic evangels, racial interpreters, mind planners, morontia counselors, technicians, recorder-teachers, and ministering reserves [39:6.1-6.8, 48:6.1, 48:6.3].
Spornagia: Intelligent and affectionate physical creatures who take charge of the physical maintenance, landscaping, and gardening of the mansion worlds [46:7.2, 47:0.4, 47:2.6].
Reversion Directors: Ministers of joy who regulate energies so that, amid the transitional pressures of intense study and training, the ascenders may relax their tension and enjoy wholesome superhuman humor and rest (recreation) [48:4.1, 48:4.3, 48:4.18].

5. Theological and Cosmic Importance (Spiritual Significance)
The rightness of experiential evolution: God does not bring creatures to divinity by a magical, instantaneous transformation [48:0.1]. Only by participating directly in and training through the stages of morontia development do human beings become qualified to possess perfect divinity and universe wisdom [48:0.2, 48:8.2].
Equal compensation for earthly deficiencies: The mansion worlds are a sanctuary of love and mercy where the universe provides a fair opportunity of compensation, so that underprivileged souls who grew up neglected like spiritual and biological orphans because of the tragedy of rebellion and default, as on Urantia, may arrive at Paradise on the same footing as those who grew up on normal planets [47:3.8, 49:6.10, 55:2.12].
The eternal unification of personality: It is a holy milestone at which the mechanical animal mind of man consummates a cosmic marriage with the "Thought Adjuster," a fragment of infinite God, thereby bringing into being an eternal and perfect divine personality that the whole universe cannot break [47:8.3, 112:7.1].

q067.question: Please summarize what is said about time, that is, how long one spends on the mansion worlds.
q067.answer:
All the statements in The Urantia Book about the time, ages, and cycles that mortals spend on the mansion worlds and the transition worlds can be summarized logically and in detail as follows.

1. First Arrival on the Mansion Worlds and the Period of Leisure (10 Days)
Ten days of personal liberty at first: After the mortal is first resurrected on the first mansion world and obtains a residence permit in the Melchizedek sector, he is at once granted ten days of personal liberty (leisure). During these ten days the ascender has time freely to explore the vicinity of his new home, become familiar with his program ahead, and go to the registry to visit loved ones and friends who have arrived earlier. Only when these ten days of leisure are over does the second stage of the Paradise journey, the serious training, begin.

2. Length of Stay on Each World and the Cycle of Advancement (10-Day Intervals)
Minimum stay and cycle of advancement (10 days): If the mortal is not detained (delayed) on the first mansion world for supplementary training, then at the end of the ten days of liberty granted after first arrival he enters the transition sleep and goes on to the second mansion world. Thereafter he advances one step at a time, every ten days, until he arrives at the world of his assignment. That is, for the ascender who is very well prepared on earth and is not detained, the minimum stay on each mansion world is ten days.
Delays and extended stays: Most mortal survivors from the normal evolutionary worlds, having many earthly deficiencies and biological and intellectual defects, stay much longer than this on the first mansion world and others, receiving corrective training.
Delay on the seventh mansion world: The ascender usually advances individually through the mansion worlds, but on the last, the seventh mansion world, he may remain additionally within certain limits in order to help a member of his group of fellow ascenders who has fallen behind to catch up with him.

3. Time Required for the Transformation of the Morontia Body (7 Days)
Seven days of standard time for the change of form: Each time the ascender advances from one mansion world to the next, he is carried by angelic transport and awakens in a new morontia body. The necessary changes in the early morontia form made by the System Co-ordinators when passing from one sphere to another take about seven days of standard time to complete.
Seven sleeps and resurrections: In passing completely through the whole mansion world career, the ascender experiences in all seven adjustment sleeps and resurrection awakenings.

4. The Period of Retirement after Fusion with the Adjuster (40 Days)
Forty days of spiritual retirement: As soon as the "perfect fusion of the human mind with the Thought Adjuster," which usually takes place during the sojourn on the fifth or sixth mansion world, is accomplished and officially confirmed, the new ascender is granted a period of forty days of spiritual retirement from all routine activities. During these forty days the ascender communes deeply with himself and takes time to decide upon one of the various optional routes and techniques for reaching Paradise.

5. Age Groups of Child Survivors and the Criterion for Entering the Mansion Worlds (Mentions of Age)
Children up to five years of age: In the nurseries of the finaliter world, infants who died without Adjusters are cared for in families of five, from under one year of age up to about five years (the standard age at which the Adjuster arrives).
Children from six to fourteen: Children and youths who died with Thought Adjusters indwelling and are repersonalized on the finaliter world are classified in the age groups from six to fourteen and grow up together in families of five.
The final choice at sixteen and entry into the mansion worlds: Children who grow up on the finaliter world may, at any time after the age of sixteen, if they choose the heavenly way, transfer to the first mansion world and begin the Paradise ascent in earnest. Therefore, judged by usual Urantia standards, children under sixteen are scarcely to be found on the mansion worlds.

6. Other Cycles and Time-Related Activities on the Mansion Worlds
Term of the parental couple commissions (10 years): The service of the parental commissions on the first mansion world, which examine the parental qualifications (experience of rearing children) of survivors, is run on a rotating basis, and the members' term of office generally lasts only ten years.
Cycle of visits to children in the nurseries (four times a year): Parents sojourning on the mansion worlds whose children are growing up in the probationary nurseries of the finaliter world are given the opportunity to co-operate with the morontia directors in the education of their children, and they are permitted to travel to the finaliter world to visit their children about four times a year.

Thus time on the mansion worlds does not simply pass aimlessly; it is strictly regulated according to a highly mathematical and organized schedule: the ten-day cycles of leisure and advancement, the seven days of standard time for bodily transformation, the forty days of spiritual retirement, and the sixteen-year criterion in the growth cycle of children.

q068.question: Please tell me about morontia mota.
q068.answer:
Here is a summary of the specific principles and the importance of morontia mota, the cosmic philosophy that the mortals of Urantia must master in the afterlife, especially in the transitional journey through the mansion worlds and the local universe, in order to overcome the limitations of time and space and comprehend universe reality.

1. The Nature and Dual Structure of Morontia Mota
Definition and level of existence: The local universe consists of three phases of real manifestation: matter, morontia, and spirit. Among these, morontia mota is a special sensitivity to reality and a technique of perception that operates on the morontia level. It serves as a stereoscopic instrument that completely obliterates the great gulf lying between the discoveries of physical science (reason) and the ministry of religious spirit (faith).
The core of its dual structure: Mota brings about a superphilosophic reconciliation that material personalities cannot achieve by themselves; its substance is founded on knowledge-reason, and its essence consists of faith-insight.
Limitations and substitutes on earth: Mortal man living in the material world of time and space does not possess morontia intelligence and therefore cannot perceive mota directly. For this reason mankind, having only rational logic, tried to fill the gap by developing metaphysics as its compensation, but this, far from illuminating, brought only cosmic confusion. Consequently, revelation is the only technique permitted on the earthly level to compensate for this absence of the truth sensitivity of mota and to clear up metaphysical confusion.

2. The Stepwise Learning of Mota through the Mansion Worlds
The mortal ascender, passing through the mansion worlds one after another, completes a course of mota education that advances from simple mechanical knowledge to high spiritual insight.
The first mansion world (the parallel method and twenty-eight statements of philosophy): Here the ascender is first introduced to the rudiments of morontia mota. To aid learning, a very distinctive parallel method is used: in one column the simplest mota meanings are presented, and in the opposite column are placed the statements of human philosophy of high quality that most nearly correspond to them, so that the student comes to understand by comparison.
The twenty-eight representative examples of human philosophy used at this time include profound cosmic truths such as the following.
"⟦Q 48:7.3⟧A display of specialized skill does not signify possession of spiritual capacity. Cleverness is not a substitute for true character⟦/Q⟧."
"⟦Q 48:7.28⟧Knowledge is possessed only by sharing; it is safeguarded by wisdom and socialized by love⟦/Q⟧."
"⟦Q 48:7.27⟧Greatness lies not so much in possessing strength as in making a wise and divine use of such strength⟦/Q⟧."
The second mansion world (mastery of meanings): The study of mota begun on the first world is deepened, and the ascender undergoes training in mastering and becoming proficient in the specific meanings of mota.
The third mansion world (harmony of reason and faith): Higher learning takes place concerning the correlation of mota with human reason and logic and their philosophic harmony. Passing through this, the ascender at last gains a real and metaphysical insight that sees through to cosmic meanings and their organic interrelationships.
The constellation level and beyond: Passing through the seventy training spheres of the constellation, mota teaches how to go beyond personal development and be integrated with the culture of social co-ordination, ethics, and administrative systems. Through this experience of mota, the assurance of truth gradually replaces the assurance of simple belief on which one formerly depended.

3. The Working Principle of Mota: Establishing a Stereoscopic View of the Universe
Overcoming the one-eyed viewpoint (stereoscopic vision): The human mind on earth views the universe only flatly. The one-eyed material scientist who trusts blindly in reason alone, or the one-eyed spiritual mystic who insists on faith alone, can neither see nor understand rightly the true depth and value of universe reality. By superimposing morontia perception upon material perception and combining them, mota grants the personality a stereoscopic depth of perspective that sees the meanings and values of the universe in full harmony.
Accepting conceptual curvature and elliptical symmetry: Material reason falls into error by trying to interpret the universe by projecting it in simple, one-dimensional linear logic. But the eye of mota fully grasps the elliptical symmetry of the universe and the essential curvature of all relative concepts, enabling one to construct a perfect cosmic philosophy that leans neither toward materialistic naturalism nor toward mystical monotony.

4. The Cosmic and Theological Importance of Mota
An indispensable tool for conceiving the universe: Without the insight of mota, man, finitely confined in time and space, could never by himself discern divine goodness, love, and truth in the physical phenomena of the material world, nor could he conceptualize and build a logical and consistent universe.
Liberation of the self through growth: Human consciousness ascends from facts to meanings, and from meanings to values. Science gives rise to fact consciousness and religion to value consciousness, and mota (revelation) co-ordinates them to yield a consciousness of true reality, leading the mortal to be safely liberated from the limitations of the material mechanism and from intellectual error.
Finding harmony in chaos: When the mortal ascends spiritually and attains spiritual insight of a high order, mota enables him to perceive and feel for himself perfect divine harmony and providence in countless universe situations that, to the former finite state of mind, appeared simply as inexplicable catastrophe or disorder, that is, as chaos.

Mota is a divine means of ascension that teaches us not merely to know the universe (knowledge) but to feel and possess with a whole heart the eternal values and meanings of God contained in it (wisdom).

q069.question: When do resurrections take place? Please tell me in detail about the millennial resurrection, the special resurrection, and the third-day resurrection.
q069.answer:
In The Urantia Book, the time at which a human (mortal) who has died is awakened again and repersonalized (resurrected) varies greatly according to the stage of spiritual and cosmic attainment (the degree of attainment of the cosmic circles) that the individual reached during the earthly life, whether he has a Thought Adjuster and a guardian angel, and the dispensations of the planet and universe needs.

Here is a detailed summary of the timing, subjects, and mechanisms of the third-day resurrection, the millennial resurrection, and the special resurrection you asked about.

1. The Third-Day Resurrection (Resurrection on the Third Day / Individual Resurrection)
Timing: It takes place on the third day after natural material death has overtaken a person.
Subjects and conditions: It applies to mortals who during their earthly life broke through animal inertia and reached the spiritual and intellectual attainment of the third cosmic circle or beyond. On reaching the third circle, a personal guardian of destiny (a personal seraphim) rather than a group guardian seraphim is assigned, and when, with the final certification of the Adjuster and the seraphim, the approval of the Ancients of Days is given, they are resurrected at once on the third day without waiting for the group adjudication of the dispensation.
Place and process: It takes place in the resurrection halls of the first mansion world of the system of Satania, which belongs to the superuniverse of Orvonton. The spiritual memory record brought by the Thought Adjuster from Divinington and the immortal morontia soul kept by the seraphic guardian unite within a newly fashioned morontia form and awaken.
Principal examples
Adam and Eve: On the third day after ending their life on earth, they were repersonalized in the resurrection halls of the mansion world of Satania together with 1,316 of their associates.
Christ Michael (Jesus): On the third day after his death on the cross (at 3:02 a.m. on Sunday, April 9, A.D. 30), he was resurrected in morontia form, in conjunction with the mechanism of the resurrection halls of the first mansion world of Satania.
For reference, the raising of Lazarus performed by Jesus of Nazareth was a material resurrection that restored a mortal to life in his very physical body, a special case that was the first and last in the history of Urantia.

2. The Millennial Resurrection
Timing: It is conducted regularly, at least every 1,000 years of planetary time, with the approval of the planetary authorities or the system rulers.
Subjects and purpose: As in the words "⟦Q 49:6.2⟧many of those who sleep in the dust awake⟦/Q⟧," there are awakened, from among the sleeping survivors who have not yet reached the third circle, have not obtained personal guardians, and remain in a state of unconscious sleep, those who need to be mobilized as groups for specific plans of ascending service in the system or the local universe.
Distinctive feature: Children and youths who died young with an Adjuster indwelling and are growing up in the probationary nurseries are also sometimes called to the resurrection halls or the finaliter world at the time of the millennial resurrection roll calls.

3. The Special Resurrection
Timing: Independently of the regular ends of dispensations or the millennial resurrections, it is carried out temporarily and specially whenever a particular purpose or need arises in universe administration.
Subjects and principal examples
It is conducted when a certain group of ascenders must be specially mobilized for particular service or training in the local universe plan of ascension.
The resurrection of Moses: In the ages before Pentecost one usually had to sleep until the group resurrection, but in the case of Moses he was taken to the morontia worlds through a special resurrection before the end of the dispensation.
Child survivors: Little children who died early with a Thought Adjuster indwelling are repersonalized at the time of their parents' arrival on the mansion worlds or at the calling of a special resurrection.

4. The Dispensational Resurrection (General Group Resurrection)
The majority of sleeping survivors, who did not obtain personal guardian angels and did not reach the third circle, wait after death in an unconscious state, without any sense of time. They awaken all together and go on to the mansion worlds through the group resurrection (the planetary roll call) that takes place when a new Paradise Son (such as an Avonal Magisterial Son) arrives on a mission to the planet and proclaims a new dispensation.
The third dispensational resurrection of Urantia: About 4:30 on Sunday morning, immediately after Jesus' morontia resurrection, Gabriel called the roll of the survivors of Urantia who had been sleeping since the Adamic age, and thus the third planetary dispensational general resurrection was accomplished.

q070.question: The role of the Paradise Sons of God (Michael, Avonal, Daynal) in the mortal epochs of a planet
q070.answer:
According to The Urantia Book, an evolutionary planet of time and space passes through seven mortal epochs, from the time life appears until it reaches the era of light and life, the highest spiritual stage. In this process the three orders of divine Sons of Paradise origin, namely the Creator Son (Michael), the Magisterial Son (Avonal), and the Trinity Teacher Son (Daynal), come down to the planet at the turning point of each epoch and play a decisive role in leading the spiritual, moral, and social maturing of mankind.

The specific roles and ministries of each of the Paradise Sons are as follows.

1. The Role of the Magisterial Son (Avonal)
Divine origin: The secondary order of Paradise Sons, born of the union of the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit.
Principal related epochs: The fourth epoch (the post-Magisterial Son age) and the fifth epoch (the bestowal Son age on an ordinary evolutionary planet).
Three ministries on the planet
Judicial actions: At the end of a planetary dispensation, they awaken the sleeping survivors in the halls of resurrection, judge the spiritual status of the planet, and proclaim a new dispensation.
Magisterial missions: When a planet needs intellectual and ethical maturing before it receives a bestowal Son, they materialize and appear on the planet not as babies born of woman but in the form of fully grown adult men. Residing on earth, they put laws and social institutions in order and foster spiritual enlightenment.
Bestowal missions: On every evolutionary world in the local universe except the single planet chosen by the Creator Son (Michael) himself, an Avonal Son incarnates as the bestowal Son of the fifth epoch. At this time he is born as a baby of a woman, personally experiences human life and death, and reveals to that race the mercy and love of the Paradise Father.

2. The Role of the Creator Son (Michael)
Divine origin: The primary order of Paradise Sons, born of the creative union of the Universal Father and the Eternal Son. In one local universe (Nebadon) there is only one Michael Creator Son.
Principal related epoch: The fifth epoch (the post-bestowal Son age).
Role and distinctive features on the planet
Designer of the local universe and its planets: He implants mortal life on the evolutionary planets and sends Planetary Princes and Adam and Eve (Material Sons) to set up the cosmic arrangements for managing the early evolution of mankind.
Creature bestowals and the attainment of supreme sovereignty: In order to understand fully the viewpoint of the creatures he has created and to acquire the supreme sovereignty of the local universe, the Michael Son carries out seven creature bestowals. Choosing only one planet (Urantia) out of the ten million inhabited planets of the universe of Nebadon, he personally completed his seventh bestowal in mortal flesh.
The pouring out of the Spirit of Truth and the universal indwelling of Thought Adjusters: When the Creator Son has finished his earthly life and resurrection and ascends as sovereign, he pours out the Spirit of Truth upon the planet. This opens the cosmic way for the Thought Adjuster, the fragment of the spirit of God the Father, to indwell universally every normal mind on the planet.

3. The Role of the Trinity Teacher Son (Daynal)
Divine origin: The tertiary order of Paradise Sons, brought into being directly by the triune Deity of the Universal Father, the Eternal Son, and the Infinite Spirit.
Principal related epochs: The sixth epoch (the post-Teacher Son age) and the seventh epoch (the era of light and life).
Role and distinctive features on the planet
Moral and spiritual educators: The Daynal Sons have nothing to do with universe administration, judicial adjudication, or the judgment of sin; they are universal teachers devoted solely to the moral enlightenment and spiritual development of creatures.
Completion of the spiritual maturing of the planet: When a planet has nearly overcome its material and intellectual problems and a world-wide spiritual awakening takes place, they volunteer and arrive on the planet as a corps. Usually one presiding Daynal Son and seventy associate Teacher Sons make up a team and carry on a ministry of spiritual illumination for about 1,000 years of planetary time (a millennium).
Supermaterial ministry: The Teacher Sons do not incarnate or materialize directly so as to be visible to mortal eyes; they commune with and teach the intelligent beings of the planet through the circuits of celestial helpers such as the Brilliant Evening Stars and the seraphim.
Entry into the era of light and life: When the millennial ministry of the Teacher Sons ends successfully, the planet at last leaves behind all struggle and imperfection and is formally settled as a sphere of the seventh epoch, light and life, the supreme goal of time and space.

Summary
The mortal epochs of an evolutionary planet consist of an elaborate co-operative program of Paradise divinity: Avonal (the Magisterial Son) puts the judicial and social foundations in order; Michael (the Creator Son) or an Avonal, through bestowal, pours out divine love and the Spirit of Truth; and finally Daynal (the Trinity Teacher Son) completes the spiritual education and leads the planet into the era of light and life.

q071.question: Please summarize the key points about the types of mortals, the brain types, spirit-receptivity, their habitats, and so on.
q071.answer:
1. Habitats (Characteristics of the Inhabited Worlds)
The local system arrangement: All the worlds inhabited by mortals are grouped into local systems, and the number of evolutionary planets per system on which mortals of actual survival status live is limited to about 1,000.
The system of Satania and Urantia: The system of Satania, to which Urantia belongs, is an unfinished system with a total of 619 inhabited worlds registered, and Urantia is the 606th world.
Varied planetary environments: Physical environments vary, some worlds revolving around a central sun and others existing as satellites of great dark planets (like Anova, the oldest inhabited world in Satania).

2. The Brain-Type Series

The organization of the brain and nervous system of mortals falls broadly into three types.

Single-brained type: Their intellectual achievements on earth are somewhat more limited than those of the double-brained type.
Double-brained type: The type to which the human beings of Urantia (earth) belong. They are more imaginative, adventurous, and philosophical than the single-brained.
Triple-brained type: They excel the double-brained in spiritual, ethical, and worshipful tendencies. Because the evolved third brain takes over the control of bodily activities, the two higher brains are set free to concentrate on intellectual activity and on the spiritual activities of the Thought Adjuster.

3. The Spirit-Receptivity Series

Contact with spiritual affairs and spiritual receptivity are influenced by gland chemistry, especially by the number of certain glandular bodies similar to the pituitary.

One-gland group (12 percent): Naturally somewhat less spiritually receptive.
Two-gland group (65 percent): The group to which the Urantia races belong, with average receptivity.
Three-gland group (23 percent): More readily inclined toward the spiritual during the life on earth.

These differences in gland chemistry pertain only to the life in the flesh and do not persist after natural death.

4. Physical Types of Mortals and Adaptation to Environment
Atmospheric and breathing types: More than 91 percent of the worlds of Satania are mid-breathers like Urantia; the rest are divided into subbreathers (2.5 percent), superbreathers (5 percent), and nonbreathers on almost airless worlds (1.5 percent).
Elemental types: In relation to habitat there are the earth type (70 percent, Urantia), the air type (10 percent), the water type (7 percent), and the combined earth-air type (13 percent).
Gravity and stature: Suited to the size and gravity of the planet, they vary in height from the 2.5-foot (about 76 centimeters) pygmies up to 10 feet (about 3 meters).
Basic races: Six Sangik races appear, including the three primary colors (red, yellow, blue) and the three secondary colors (orange, green, indigo).

5. Orders of Terrestrial Escape and Resurrection
The dispensational or group order of survival: Called collectively at the inauguration of a new dispensation and repersonalized on the first mansion world.
The individual orders of ascension: Mortals who attained the third of the cosmic circles during the earthly life and were assigned personal seraphic guardians of destiny; regardless of the dispensational roll calls, they are resurrected on the third day after death.
The probationary-dependent orders: Children who die young, before the indwelling of a Thought Adjuster, are repersonalized on the finaliter world of the system (the probationary nursery) when their surviving parent arrives on the mansion worlds.
The primary modified order (translation order): Beings who attained complete fusion with their Thought Adjusters during the earthly life; without passing through the gateway of death, they are translated directly from among the living into the morontia state and ascend.

q072.question: How are the conditions of the primary modified order (translation) related to the era of light and life?
q072.answer:
The primary modified order (translation) and the era of light and life stand in a key relationship that shows how the spiritual perfection of the individual mortal is linked with the evolutionary climax of the whole planet.

1. Conditions of the Primary Modified Order (the Translation Order)
Fusion with the Adjuster during the earthly life: The ascending mortals who belong to the primary modified order are those who, while living in the flesh on earth, achieve perfect spiritual harmony with the indwelling Thought Adjuster and actually attain fusion with the Adjuster during the mortal life.
Exemption from physical (natural) death: They do not pass through the ordinary gateway of bodily death; consenting to the grasp of the Adjuster, they are clothed in morontia form from among the living and are immediately translated and ascend.
Direct transfer to the higher morontia spheres: The fused souls are transferred directly by the Adjuster and enter straightway into the presence of the Sovereign Son at the local universe headquarters, or into the resurrection halls of a higher morontia sphere.

2. The Close Relationship to the Era of Light and Life
The universalization of the phenomenon of translation: As a planet, after the successive ministries of the divine Sons, enters and is settled in the era of light and life, the climax of mortal evolution, the number of people who fuse with their Adjusters during the earthly life and go forward as the primary modified order increases dramatically.
The official criterion of planetary settledness: When the majority of the mortals leaving a planetary realm ascend through this translation (primary modified) order without passing through natural death, then at last that planet is recognized as officially belonging to this series.
The gradual disappearance of natural death: On spheres long settled in light and life, natural death from disease or aging becomes more and more rare, and the majority of the inhabitants attain spiritual maturity and go on through natural translation to the morontia worlds of the universe beyond.

In summary, the primary modified order (translation) is the highest state of spiritual maturity that an individual can attain, and the era of light and life signifies the advanced evolutionary state in which such individual spiritual perfection appears in the great majority of the inhabitants of the whole planet.

q073.question: Shall we go on to look at the radical changes in social, political, and spiritual life that take place on a planet settled in the era of light and life, and at the ways of direct contact with the morontia world?
q073.answer:
A planet settled in the Era of Light and Life displays a social, political, and spiritual completeness on an entirely different level from the early evolutionary worlds such as Urantia (earth), and it lives a marvelous cosmic life directly connected with the morontia and spiritual worlds.

Here is a summary of the central changes of the era of light and life, as revealed in The Urantia Book, and of the ways of contact with the morontia world.

1. Radical Changes in Politics and Society

The withering of government and the establishment of self-rule: As self-control (self-mastery) becomes perfectly established, man-made laws and penalties gradually become unnecessary, and armies and police pass into history. The labor time needed from each adult for the material maintenance of society is greatly reduced, to about one hour a day (by Urantia time).

The economy and a rational system of taxation: Public goods and natural resources are administered as the property of the community. Finances are run by a system of the tithe of ten percent, which is clearly allotted and used as follows: three percent for the promotion of truth (science, education, philosophy), three percent for beauty (art, play, social life), three percent for the realization of goodness (social service, religion), and one percent as an insurance reserve against old age, illness, and accident.

Social unity and honor: The whole planet is united in one language, one religion, and one race, and war and conflict disappear entirely. The highest honor a citizen can receive in this age is the "Order of Supreme Service," conferred in the morontia temple. Men and women equally carry out the duties of home and school, and judicial and administrative positions, as couples and in joint names.

2. Spiritual Life and the Change in the Afterlife through "Translation"

The disappearance of natural death and the translation of life: As disease and degeneration are conquered, death ceases to be a necessary gateway. The majority of the inhabitants attain complete fusion with their Thought Adjusters during their earthly lives and, without passing through natural death, are translated from among the living immediately into the morontia state and ascend.

From funerals to festivals of joy: When the candidate for ascension lies down in the center of the morontia temple, a spiritual flame (the translation flash) occurs, and he leaves the body of flesh and is clothed as a morontia being. At this moment family and friends, instead of grief and lamentation, gather in the morontia temple and hold a farewell of ecstatic joy and deep satisfaction, celebrating the eternal ascension.

Exemption from passing through the lower mansion worlds: Souls translated from such settled spheres need not pass through the corrective courses of the early mansion worlds; they go directly to the higher educational worlds of the local universe headquarters (Salvington), serve there as teachers, and then continue the Paradise ascent.

3. Ways of Direct Contact with the Morontia World

The appearance of the morontia temple: When a planet enters the era of light and life, a beautiful morontia temple, built by the Morontia Power Supervisors and the Master Physical Controllers on the model of a miniature of the system capital, rises on earth. Accommodating about 300,000 persons, this temple becomes a sacred place where cosmic meditation, the ceremonies of ascension translation, and the graduation exercises of the schools of cosmic philosophy are held.

Midway creatures become visible: Through the discoveries of expanded physical science and the co-operation of the Master Physical Controllers, the midway creatures (beings of the intermediate realm), formerly invisible, become directly visible to human eyes and act as practical liaison and assistants helping the Planetary Sovereign and the corps of finaliters.

Contact with the corps of finaliters and the visible rulers: The Corps of the Finality, returned after completing the Paradise ascent, take part directly in planetary administration as volunteers, and the Material Son and Daughter (Adam and Eve) and the Planetary Sovereign (a Lanonandek Son) associate freely with the inhabitants as visible physical and morontia leaders.

Universe broadcasts and real-time cosmic contact: As one reads a daily newspaper, the inhabitants, through the broadcast theater of the morontia temple, hear and see in real time the universe reports and news of the vast cosmos coming in from the superuniverse and Paradise, enjoying a vivid universe citizenship.

The process by which the mortals of an evolutionary planet escape the limitations of the flesh and open the era of light and life, blessed by all the universe, is the achievement that most dramatically demonstrates the love of the Universal Father and the wisdom of the evolutionary plan.

q074.question: What is the Reserve Corps of Destiny?
q074.answer:
The "⟦Q 114:7.1⟧Reserve Corps of Destiny⟦/Q⟧" revealed in The Urantia Book is a special group of servants selected by the superhuman celestial beings in charge of world administration from among the living men and women of earth, held in readiness for planetary emergencies and spiritual crises [114:7.1].

As your question suggests, most of the people included in this reserve live without being aware that they are reservists [114:7.8]. Here is a summary of the related details and the cosmic mechanisms involved.

1. Why Are They Included and Active "Without Knowing It"?

Unconscious training and rehearsal: According to the record at the time, there were 962 reservists on earth, and apart from fewer than twenty "contact personalities," most of them are wholly unaware that they are being trained for specific planetary crises [114:7.8].

Superconscious operation: The Thought Adjuster, the personal guardian seraphim, and the midway creatures work together to carry out unconscious deep training and rehearsals for emergency missions while the mortal is asleep or in a deep superconscious state [109:2.6, 114:7.8].

Preservation of essential information: As they go about their everyday lives, they unconsciously serve as a cosmic safeguard, preserving the important historical and spiritual information of the planet and the heritage of truth [114:7.10, 114:6.20].

2. Conditions for Selection to the Reserve Corps of Destiny

The superhuman administrators choose for the reserve corps mortals who possess the following intellectual and spiritual qualifications [114:7.1].

Intellectual maturity and attainment of the cosmic circles: They harbor self-conscious Thought Adjusters, and most of them are beings who have conquered the third cosmic circle of personality growth or beyond [114:7.2].

Assignment of a personal guardian angel: As soon as they enter the reserve corps, a personal seraphic guardian of destiny, not a group guardian angel, is formally assigned to them, and they receive full protection [113:1.5, 114:7.2].

Ability to rehearse emergency missions: They must have a special adaptive capacity to rehearse emergency missions in the depths of the psyche, in keeping with the projected plans of the superhuman administrators [114:7.4].

Unselfish devotion without reward: They must be willing to serve some spiritual, social, or moral purpose wholeheartedly, without worldly honor or reward and without human recognition [114:7.5].

Extraordinary Thought Adjusters: These are cases in which an experienced Thought Adjuster indwells them, one that has handled similar planetary crises on other worlds in the past or is highly adaptable [114:7.6].

3. The Organization and Role of the Urantia Reserve Corps

Linked with the twelve corps of the master seraphim: The reserve corps of earth is organized into twelve groups, each corresponding to one of the twelve seraphic divisions that supervise the planet (the angels of the epochs, of progress, of the churches, of nation life, of the future, and so on) [114:7.7].

Decisive action in emergencies: When civilization is in danger of collapse or the light of living truth is at risk of being extinguished, these unconscious reservists, through the mediation of the midway creatures, adjust personalities and circumstances and function as decisive strongholds for saving society [114:7.8, 114:7.9].

The cosmic citizenship reserve: On Urantia there also serves a "cosmic reserve corps" of more than one thousand persons who possess an insight into universe citizenship that transcends space [114:7.13].

In the end, members of the reserve corps are not people who display special visions or supernatural powers; they are precious workers secretly chosen and used by the superhuman administrators from among those who do the will of God in daily life, love their fellows unselfishly, and uphold the values of truth [108:2.9, 114:7.1].

q075.question: Please tell me about the rebellions that have occurred in the local universe of Nebadon.
q075.answer:
The records of The Urantia Book concerning the number of rebellions that occurred in the local universe of Nebadon and the system of Satania, the planets that joined them, and the beings who took part in them are as follows.

1. The Number of Rebellions in the Local Universe of Nebadon

In the entire history of Nebadon, system rebellions in which a System Sovereign of the order of Lanonandek Sons rose up against the universe government have occurred three times in all [119:2.1, 120:1.6, 53:0.2].

The first rebellion: the rebellion raised by Lutentia, System Sovereign of system 11 in constellation 37 [119:2.1, 119:2.4].

The second rebellion: a rebellion that occurred in system 87 of constellation 61 [119:3.1].

The third rebellion (the most recent): the rebellion raised by Lucifer, System Sovereign of Satania [53:0.1].

Of the 10,000 inhabited systems in all of Nebadon, only these three System Sovereigns held the universe government in contempt and led rebellions [53:0.2].

2. Information on the Planets Involved in the Satania Rebellion

Number of planets involved: Of the 607 (or 619) inhabited worlds belonging to the system of Satania, the Planetary Princes of 37 planets defected and sided with the rebel forces [15:14.5, 53:7.1]. Urantia (earth, planet number 606) was one of them [15:14.5, 67:1.2].

The exception of Panoptia: Among the 37 Planetary Princes who attempted to join the rebellion, on the planet Panoptia, under the guidance of the Melchizedeks and the wise leadership of a mortal woman named Elanora, the entire population stood united, rejected the apostasy of their Planetary Prince, and remained loyal to Michael, with not a single one joining the rebellion [53:7.1].

Condition of the involved planets (spiritual quarantine): When the rebellion broke out, the broadcasts and the interplanetary spiritual communication circuits were at once severed by the universe circuit supervisors, and the 37 planets involved were completely isolated (quarantined) from the outer universe circuits [53:7.3, 108:4.4].

3. The Principal Beings Who Took Part in the Rebellion

① The chief instigators and leadership

Lucifer: System Sovereign of Satania (a primary Lanonandek, number 37) and the supreme instigator of the rebellion [53:0.1].

Satan: Lucifer's first assistant and lieutenant (a primary Lanonandek Son) [53:1.4, 53:2.2].

Caligastia: The Planetary Prince of Urantia (secondary Lanonandek number 9,344) [66:1.1, 53:1.4].

Daligastia: Caligastia's planetary associate (secondary Lanonandek number 319,407) [66:2.2].

Abaddon: Caligastia's chief of staff and the chief executive of the Urantia rebels [53:1.5].

Beelzebub: The leader of the disloyal midway creatures who allied themselves with Caligastia [53:1.5].

② The proportion and situation of those involved in each order

Lanonandek Sons: In all of Nebadon about 700 Lanonandek Sons joined the rebellion, most of them Planetary Princes and tertiary Lanonandeks [35:9.6].

Material Sons and Daughters (Adamites): Of the 681,227 Material Sons residing on the Satania system capital (Jerusem) and elsewhere, no less than 95 percent were deceived by Lucifer's sophistries and joined the rebellion [53:7.8].

Midway creatures (midwayers):

Primary midwayers: Of the 50,000 on Urantia, 40,119 (more than 80 percent) joined Caligastia [67:3.2, 77:7.1].

Secondary midwayers: Of the 1,984, 873 joined [77:7.2].

The angelic hosts (seraphim and cherubim):

When the chief of the Satania administrative seraphim sided with Lucifer, more than one third of the administrative seraphim sympathized with the rebellion [53:6.2, 53:7.6].

One third of the angelic assistants of the Material Sons and about ten percent of the transition ministers were ensnared [53:7.7].

But not a single one of the highest order, the supreme seraphim, joined [53:7.6].

Earthly mortals: Vast numbers of the primitive peoples of the 37 involved planets were deceived by their princes' false declarations of liberty and fell into disorder and confusion [67:5.1].

③ The loyal beings who took no part at all in the rebellion

The ascending mortal citizens of Jerusem: Of the ascending mortal citizens then living on Jerusem, the system capital, numbering 187,432,811, not a single one joined the rebellion; they kept 100 percent loyalty [53:7.10, 53:7.12].

Beings of Paradise origin: Not a single one of the spiritual beings of Paradise origin (Solitary Messengers, Melchizedeks, Archangels, Brilliant Evening Stars, Trinity Sons, and so on) was involved in the rebellion [53:7.4, 53:7.5].

q076.question: The corporeal staff of one hundred (Caligastia's one hundred): their origin, how they were incarnated and materialized, their activities on earth, and the traces they left in the Bible and in ancient legends
q076.answer:
1. Origin of the Corporeal Staff of One Hundred

Selection from the volunteers of Jerusem: After Caligastia was appointed Planetary Prince of Urantia, he personally chose one hundred from among the more than 785,000 ascending citizens of Jerusem, the system capital, who had volunteered for the Urantia adventure.

Diversity of planetary origin: Each of these one hundred came from a different evolutionary planet, and not one of them was from Urantia.

Sex composition: The members of the one hundred were evenly divided, fifty men and fifty women.

Spiritual status: They enjoyed provisional citizenship on Jerusem, but before coming to earth they had not yet attained full spiritual fusion with their Thought Adjusters.

2. Method of Incarnation and Materialization

Seraphic transport: The one hundred volunteers from Jerusem arrived on Urantia carried by seraphic transports, in a state of spiritual sleep.

Extraction and implantation of earthly plasm: The Life Carriers of Urantia selected one hundred of the best Andonites (fifty men and fifty women) from among the descendants of the first human pair (Andon and Fonta) and extracted their living germ plasm.

Special reconstruction of bodies: The physical bodies to be worn by the one hundred citizens of Jerusem were newly constructed, suited to the earthly environment, with the life plasm of these Andonites infused into them. Through this process they came to have bodies biologically and outwardly similar to those of the primitive humans of earth.

Detachment of the Thought Adjusters: During this mission the Thought Adjusters of the one hundred were temporarily detached and remained on Jerusem.

A ten-day process: From the moment the seraphic transports arrived until they awoke on earth as conscious triune beings took exactly ten days.

Physical immortality and the tree of life: The life-circuit complement of the Satania system circulated in the bodies of the staff. By eating the fruit and leaves of the tree of life planted in the central courtyard of Dalamatia, they were able to continue in a state of physical deathlessness (immortality), not experiencing natural death. (The one hundred Andonites who had contributed their plasm were also given this complement and served together with the staff in immortal bodies.)

3. What They Did When They Came (Activities and Achievements)

Building the planetary capital, Dalamatia: They built Dalamatia, the planetary headquarters city, in the region of the Persian Gulf (Mesopotamia) and made it the base of civilization.

Organization of ten specialized councils (ten members each):

The council on food and material welfare (Ang): taught well digging, irrigation agriculture, the making of clothing, and so on.

The board of animal domestication and utilization: promoted the taming and use of wild animals.

The board of predatory animal control: protected man from dangerous predators.

The faculty of dissemination and conservation of knowledge: passed on language, writing, and the heritage of knowledge.

The commission on industry and trade (Nod): put barter in order and laid the foundations of primitive industry.

The college of revealed religion (Hap): replaced supernatural fear (ghost cults) with reverence for God. Disseminated the seven hymns of worship and the "Father's prayer."

The commission on health (Lut): gave instruction in sanitation, cleanliness, disease prevention, and health care.

The council on the arts and sciences: promoted the basic branches of learning, technology, and the arts.

The council on tribal government (Tut): laid the foundations of self-government and representative government among the tribes.

The supreme court of tribal co-ordination and justice (Van): was in charge of ethical adjustment and administrative justice.

Patient evolutionary education: Not by compulsion or sudden revolution, but by bringing the able young people of the surrounding tribes into the schools of Dalamatia, educating them, and then sending them back to their tribes as teachers, they raised civilization naturally.

Introduction of the seven-day week: Dividing the lunar month (28 days) into four parts, they introduced for the first time the idea of the week as a unit of seven days.

The creation of the primary midwayers: Not through physical sexual union but through the phenomenon of the union of their morontia selves (mind and soul), the staff brought into being 50,000 primary midwayers, invisible to the eyes of earthly humans, and made active use of them in planetary administration.

The division at the time of the Lucifer rebellion: When the Lucifer rebellion broke out after about 300,000 years of service, sixty (Nod, Lut, Tut, and others) followed Caligastia into rebellion, while forty (Van, Hap, Ang, and others) remained loyal to the universe government. The sixty who joined the rebellion were at once cut off from the tree of life circuit and reduced to ordinary mortals, and through sexual union with the Andonite descendants they became the ancestors of the Nodites.

4. References in the Bible and in the Legends of Earth's History

The "Nephilim" and the "sons of God" of Genesis 6:4: The passage in the book of Genesis, "There were Nephilim on the earth in those days... when the sons of God came in to the daughters of men, and they bore children to them, these were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown," derives precisely from the actual historical event in which the rebel staff members (the ancestors of the Nodites) and their descendants intermingled with earthly mankind.

The Land of Nod: The dwelling place of the staff member Nod and his descendants, who left Dalamatia after the rebellion and moved to the northeast, came to be called the "land of Nod" in later records, and it is the source of the "land of Nod" to which Cain fled in the book of Genesis.

Myths of the descent of the gods: The memory of one hundred superhuman beings who actually wore bodies of flesh, lived among the human tribes, taught them civilization, and intermarried with them became the direct prototype of the ancient myths of all the peoples of the world that "the gods came down from heaven, taught men, and married them."

The longevity records of the Sumerian kings: That the life spans of the ancient kings are recorded on Sumerian clay tablets as lasting hundreds of years or more reflects the actual life spans of the staff and their direct descendants, who survived for long periods by means of the tree of life complement.

In the history of this evolutionary planet, this staff of one hundred, though divided by the tragedy of rebellion, were truly decisive superhuman leaders who laid the foundations of civilization and spiritual light for earthly mankind.

q077.question: The origin of the Material Sons and Daughters of Jerusem as revealed in The Urantia Book, their role on Jerusem, and their relation to Adam and Eve
q077.answer:
1. Origin and Physical and Spiritual Nature

Divine origin: The Material Sons and Daughters are offspring born of the creative union between the Creator Son of the local universe (Michael) and the Universe Mother Spirit, who represents the Infinite Spirit [37:9.9, 51:1.1].

The link between the material and the spiritual worlds: They serve as the last physical link in the chain of personality that reaches from invisible divinity and perfection down to the lowest material human beings [45:5.3, 51:6.5].

Appearance and biological traits: They are created in pairs, male and female, and are able to reproduce [37:9.9]. They are about eight to ten feet tall (about 2.4 to 3 meters) and their bodies radiate a brilliant violet light [51:1.3].

Dual nutrition: They have a dual system of nutrition, taking in ordinary material energy as food while at the same time directly absorbing the continuous energy of the universe, thereby maintaining their immortal state [51:1.4].

Thought Adjusters: While residing on Jerusem and at the time of their initial assignment they have no indwelling Thought Adjuster, but through their mission of service on an evolutionary planet they receive Adjusters and become qualified to ascend to Paradise [51:1.6].

2. Role and Service on Jerusem

Permanent citizens of the system capital: They possess great estates (the Adamic domains) on Jerusem, the capital of the local system, and reside there as permanent citizens of Jerusem [37:9.9, 45:5.2, 45:5.5].

Self-government: On the basis of universal suffrage and representative government they constitute a highly self-governing society and directly manage the routine administration and material affairs of Jerusem [45:5.5, 45:5.6].

Providing parental and family experience for ascenders:

To ascending mortals, midwayers, and seraphim who died on the evolutionary planets without having had parental experience (the rearing of children), or who suffered environmental deprivation, they offer the opportunity to help care for and rear the children of the Adamic families of Jerusem [45:6.3, 45:6.4, 45:6.5].

In this way they help these ascenders make up for and be educated in the experience of the cosmic "parent-child relationship," which is essential to the Paradise ascent [45:6.4].

Melchizedek education: On Jerusem they receive spiritual and intellectual training that is perfect in scope and technique through the powerful educational institutions conducted by the Melchizedek Sons [45:5.7].

3. Relation to Adam and Eve and Assignment to the Planets

Biological uplifters: When an evolutionary planet reaches the peak of its physical and intellectual development, by order of the System Sovereign a pair of Material Son and Daughter who have volunteered from the senior corps of Material Sons on Jerusem are sent to that planet as its "Adam and Eve" [51:0.1, 51:2.1].

The record of the Adam and Eve of Urantia (earth):

The Adam and Eve who were sent to Urantia were number 14,311 of the senior corps of Material Sons on Jerusem [74:1.1].

Before coming to earth they had spent more than 15,000 years in the physical laboratories of Jerusem, where they served as directors of the laboratories, and they had also served as teachers in the citizenship schools of Jerusem [74:1.2].

When they departed for earth, they left behind on Jerusem one hundred pure-line children (fifty sons and fifty daughters) [74:1.5].

The formation of the violet race: On arriving on the planet, Adam and Eve form the "violet race," and through their descendants they implant superior life plasm into the primitive humanity of the planet, taking on the role of dramatically uplifting the biological, intellectual, and spiritual receptivity of mankind [51:3.3, 51:5.6].

Destiny after the planetary mission: Even an Adam and Eve who have completed their mission or who have made a tragic mistake are, after repentance, repersonalized through a dispensational resurrection as ascending citizens of Jerusem, and thereafter they either go on to the Paradise Corps of the Finality or are assigned to such bodies as the Twenty-four Counselors of Jerusem, serving as planetary directors [45:4.11, 45:4.12, 76:6.3, 76:6.4].

q078.question: Please summarize the evolution of the colored races, from the Sangik races down to the modern white and yellow races of mankind.
q078.answer:
The evolution of the colored races as described in The Urantia Book is a grand cosmic evolutionary chronicle that begins with the appearance of the Sangik races about 500,000 years ago and, through amalgamation with the Adamites and the Andites, leads down to modern mankind (the white, yellow, and black races).

1. The Origin of the Sangik Races and the Appearance of the Six Colored Races

Simultaneous appearance in a single family: About 500,000 years ago, in one family of the Badonan tribe, descendants of the primitive Andonites who dwelt in the highlands of northwestern India, nineteen children were born. They were not only more intelligent than their fellows, but they also had a genetic mutation that made their skin change color when exposed to sunlight.

The six colored races: From these nineteen Sangik children the six basic colored races differentiated simultaneously.

The red race (five children): The most intelligent; they were the first to develop tribal civilization and government, and they practiced monogamy.

The orange race (two children): A race with a strong building instinct, piling up enormous mounds of stone.

The yellow race (four children): The race that gave up hunting and was the first to establish settled homes based on agriculture.

The green race (two children): A race somewhat inferior in ability.

The blue race (four children): The race that invented the spear, excelled in artistic and technical gifts, and combined the brains of the red man with the soul and emotions of the yellow man.

The indigo race (the black race, two children): The last to leave the homeland, a race excelling in physical strength.

2. The Historical Development and Migrations of the Six Sangik Races

The primary Sangik races (red, yellow, and blue):

The red race: After fierce wars with the yellow race in Asia, they crossed the Bering land bridge to the American continent about 85,000 years ago and were isolated there, becoming the ancestors of the American Indians.

The yellow race: With their strong social solidarity and spirit of brotherhood, they formed united settlements throughout East Asia.

The blue race: They migrated throughout Europe, mixed with the Neanderthal descendants of the Andonites, and developed into the Cro-Magnons, becoming the principal biological foundation of the white race.

The secondary Sangik races (orange, green, and indigo):

The orange race: They moved into Africa, but after a hundred years' war with the green race, which entered later, they became extinct as a distinct race about 100,000 years ago.

The green race: In the course of their struggles with the yellow, blue, and indigo races, they were absorbed or exterminated.

The indigo race: They entered the African continent, absorbed the remnants of the green and orange races, and settled throughout Africa.

3. The Violet Race (Adamites) and the Amalgamation of the Andites

The sending of the biological uplifters: About 35,000 years ago, Adam and Eve, a Material Son and Daughter (the violet race), arrived on earth as biological uplifters.

The formation of the Andites: After the default in the Garden of Eden, the violet-race stock of Adam blended with the Nodites of the Dalamatian era and with the Sangik races, and thus was born the Andites, a mixed race of the highest order.

The spread of civilization: Drawing on their adventurousness, skill, humor, commerce, and military wisdom, the Andites went out from Mesopotamia and Central Asia and spread over the whole world, to Europe, India, China, North Africa, and elsewhere, developing civilization.

4. The Three Racial Classifications of Modern Mankind and the Formation of the White and Yellow Races

Modern mankind, through the complex remixing of the five basic heritages of the past (Andonite, primary Sangik, secondary Sangik, Nodite, and Adamite), falls into three broad categories.

① The Caucasoid / white race

Composition: It was formed on the basis of the blue race of Europe (the Cro-Magnons) as its basic framework and source of physical vigor, into which was infused a great amount of Andite stock (the union of Adamites and Nodites), with Andonite elements mixed in.

The three western groups: The white race of Europe was formerly distinguished into the Nordic (northern), Alpine (central), and Mediterranean (southern) races, but continuous intermixture over the last several thousand years has now made it a thoroughly blended white race.

② The Mongoloid / yellow race

Composition: It is based on the primary Sangik races (red, yellow, and blue).

Process of formation: With the yellow race of East Asia at its center, it absorbed the Andonite Siberians, the remnants of the red race, and the superior genes of the Andites who came in by way of Sinkiang and Tibet.

Characteristics: It avoided intermixture with inferior primate and Neanderthal stocks, and through internal peace, strong family and ancestor worship, and agricultural co-operation it has preserved the longest-continuing and most stable large-scale cultural civilization in the world.

③ The Negroid / black race

Composition: It is based on the secondary Sangik races (orange, green, and indigo) and is found in Africa, India, Indonesia, and elsewhere.

5. The Cosmic Significance of the Differentiation of the Colored Races

The reasons why the appearance of several colored races is planned on the evolutionary worlds are as follows.

Flexibility for natural selection: It provides a range among diverse traits within which superior stocks can be selected and survive.

Strengthening through race mixture: Through the crossing of races possessing superior genetic factors, new races that are stronger and more excellent appear.

Healthy competition and altruism: Racial and cultural differences provide a healthy stimulus in human society and become an essential foundation for learning and developing tolerance and altruism.

q079.question: Please tell me about the ultimaton, and explain in detail the process by which ultimatons come into being, their properties, and their relation to the electron.
q079.answer:
The ultimaton is, as revealed in The Urantia Book, the most primal energy particle of the physical universe and the basic unit of all material construction. Here is a summary of the definition of the ultimaton, the process of its formation, its physical properties, and its relation to the electron.

1. Definition and Concept of the Ultimaton

The basic unit of matter: The ultimaton is the most fundamental physical unit of material existence and the basic energy particle of which the electron is composed.

The first materialization of primal energy: It is the first measurable form of energy that emerges when the nonspiritual energy going out from Paradise materializes in the universes of time and space, and it has the Isle of Paradise as its nucleus.

2. The Process Leading to the Ultimaton (Dynamics of Formation)

From space potency to primordial force: The Primary Master Force Organizers of Paradise penetrate the space potency (absoluta) of the Unqualified Absolute and stir up gigantic cyclones, transmuting primal space energy into primordial force (segregata).

Advancement to emergent energy (ultimata): Responding to the continuing rotation and tension of the master force organizers, primordial force advances to emergent energy (ultimata), the stage of puissant energy (primary emergent energy) and gravity energy (secondary emergent energy), which begin to respond to Paradise gravity.

The definite appearance of the ultimaton: Within the gigantic whirls of force set up by the master force organizers, energy continues to gather and condense, until at last the ultimaton appears, the basic unit particle of which physical energy is composed.

Handing over to the subsequent organizers of matter: When energy has condensed into ultimatons and reached the stage of responding to the gravity circuits, the Paradise master force organizers complete their charge and withdraw, and the subsequent electromagnetic and physical organization of matter is handed over to the superuniverse power directors, the power centers, and the Master Physical Controllers.

3. Principal Properties and Characteristics of the Ultimaton

Indestructibility (extreme stability): The ultimaton is the most highly condensed and stable energy particle in the universe. In the super-high temperature of 35,000,000 degrees and the extreme pressures inside the suns, atoms and electrons, and even the associations of ultimatons, can be broken up, but the heat and pressure of the sun itself cannot further split or destroy the ultimaton. Only when it takes part in the final disruption of a cooling, dead sun does the ultimaton escape from physical existence and return to the preceding stage.

Exemption from local (linear) gravity: The ultimaton is not affected by the local (linear) gravity exerted by great celestial bodies or by ordinary masses of matter. It drifts through vast universe space, fully obedient only to the circular gravity of the Isle of Paradise and the universal revolving circuits of the cosmos.

The three inherent motions of the ultimaton: The ultimaton has three distinctive motions: 1) mutual resistance to cosmic force, 2) individual axial revolution with antigravity potential, and 3) the intra-electronic position and circuit motion of the one hundred mutually interassociated ultimatons when they make up an electron.

Temperature and antigravity properties: By accelerating its axial revolution the ultimaton can exhibit partial antigravity behavior, but without the intervention of the force organizers or power directors it cannot of itself attain the degravitating escape velocity needed to return to the preceding energy stage. The cold temperature of space promotes the process by which ultimatons cluster and are organized into electronic structures.

4. The Relation between the Ultimaton and the Electron

The basic building unit of the electron: Exactly one hundred ultimatons bound together by mutual attraction form one typical electron. If even one of the hundred ultimatons is lost, the identity of the typical electron is destroyed, and it becomes one of the ten modified forms of the electron.

Determining the size and charge of the electron: Within the electron the ultimatons do not circle in planetary orbits like satellites, but according to their axial revolutionary velocity they spread out or cluster together, thereby determining the size and dimensions of the electron. Likewise, the axial revolutionary velocity of the constituent ultimatons determines whether the electron carries a negative or a positive charge.

The emergence of linear gravity (mass) and materiality: Individual ultimatons and unattached free electrons show no linear-gravity response, but when one hundred ultimatons come together to form an electron, and this in turn makes up a material system revolving in orbit around an atomic nucleus, then at last there emerges a material character that is fully responsive to linear gravity (mass).

Manipulation by the power controllers: The universe power centers and the Master Physical Controllers skillfully manipulate the ultimaton, the basic unit of materialized energy, transforming it into the circuits and revolutions of the electron, and thereby they control universe power and organize matter.

q080.question: Please summarize the relationship among matter, mind, and spirit in The Urantia Book.
q080.answer:
