The metaphor of "attending kindergarten over and over again in the university of the universe" is the most apt analogy for contrasting the ascension plan of The Urantia Book with the inefficiency of the idea of reincarnation.

3.1 The Curriculum of the Universe: One-Directional Progress

In The Urantia Book, a material world such as Urantia is the kindergarten or first-grade course where the eternal career of the mortal begins. A single life on this planet is the opportunity to choose eternal survival.

Graduation (death): When a mortal who has chosen survival dies, he goes on at once to the next educational institution.

Elementary education (the mansion worlds): The first mansion world is the elementary course, where the mortal makes up for what was lacking in the material life and learns the basic attainments of a universe citizen.

Higher education (the universe journey): Then, passing through institutions of higher education such as the Melchizedek schools, he follows as an ascending mortal the college and graduate courses of the vast universe.

The final goal (Paradise): This whole journey aims at finally reaching Paradise and finding God.

3.2 The Inefficiency of Reincarnation: Cyclical Stagnation

Compared with this model of one-directional progress, reincarnation is an extremely inefficient and stagnant system.

If the plan of the universe is to educate mortals to perfection, why would it readmit them again and again into the same environment (the material world, that is, the kindergarten) whose imperfection has already been demonstrated, and moreover with all the lessons (memories) of the previous grade erased? That would be an educationally failed system, the very "⟦Q 94:2.3⟧weary and monotonous round⟦/Q⟧" that Melchizedek criticized.

The mansion world system is far more efficient and merciful. It moves the mortal directly into a better environment and begins customized remedial education while he retains all his memories and his personality. Therefore reincarnation is not progress but stagnation, not hope but punishment.

4. The Phenomenon of "Past-Life Memories": An Inheritance of Experience, Not a Reincarnation of Personality

The central thesis of this essay is that The Urantia Book does not deny the phenomenon itself that feels like a memory of a past life. On the contrary, four possibilities far more refined than reincarnation can be considered as reasons why such phenomena may occur.

What all four have in common is that personality is never transferred. What is transferred is only data, memories, and values. This is not the recycling of personality but the conservation and inheritance of experience.

Comparison: Traditional Reincarnation and the Four Explanations

Traditional reincarnation: The same personality (soul) passes on, carrying personality, memory, and karma. Its purpose is the resolution of karma and purification, and it is held to apply to everyone.
Explanation 1, the Thought Adjuster: An experienced Adjuster carries the memories and experiences of a previous mortal. It is an incidental phenomenon, not an intended one, and the memories are someone else's. It may be relatively common.
Explanation 2, the guardian angel: The guardian angel keeps the mind pattern of a previous mortal. It is an unintended prompting, and the memories are someone else's. It is rare (cases of reassignment after a failure to survive).
Explanation 3, the reserve corps of destiny: Data from a particular life are transmitted through the liaison of two Thought Adjusters. It has a purpose, for a planetary mission, and the data are someone else's. It is very rare.
Explanation 4, the Supreme Being: One resonates with collective experiential values through the cosmic mind. It is an unintended resonance, and the values are collective rather than individual. Its frequency is unknown.

4.1 Explanation 1: The Experienced Thought Adjuster

The most likely and most personal explanation is through the Thought Adjuster. The Urantia Book says that on the two-brain worlds virgin Adjusters are seldom assigned to persons who have unquestioned capacity for survival (109:3.6). In other words, the Thought Adjusters within us are very likely Adjusters that have gained experience on other planets.

If so, a hypothesis can be formed: might it be that the memories of other, nonsurviving mortals kept by the Adjuster feel like past-life experiences when we make contact with the Adjuster?

The process can be described as follows. First, my Adjuster formerly indwelt mortal A. Second, A failed to survive. Third, the Adjuster came to mortal B (me), retaining A's experiences and memories. Fourth, when I make deep contact with the Adjuster through meditation or profound reflection, vivid memories of A kept by the Adjuster (particular places, skills, fears) rise to the surface of consciousness. Fifth, I mistake these memories of another person for memories of my own past life.

This is not a reincarnation of personality but a touching of the record of a previous person preserved in the divine repository that is the Adjuster.

4.2 Explanation 2: The Guardian Angel

The second explanation is through the guardian angel. During the interval between death and the morontia resurrection, the guardian angel takes custody of the mind pattern, the memory system, and the reality of the surviving soul.

When a person fails to fuse with the Adjuster (fails to survive), that guardian angel may be sent to serve again on the same planet.

So the following hypothesis is possible: some prompting given to us by a guardian angel who is preserving the identity of another person might function like a memory of a past life. A guardian angel was in charge of mortal A, and A failed to survive. The angel, keeping A's mind pattern and memories, is reassigned as the guardian angel of mortal B (me). When B meets a crisis similar to A's, the angel may draw on A's experience to give hints or inspiration, and B may feel this prompting that came from outside as a past-life memory that came from within.

4.3 Explanation 3: The Reserve Corps of Destiny

This is not a common phenomenon; it is a very rare case that applies only to a special group with planetary assignments called the reserve corps of destiny.

When a reservist nears death, data concerning a particular life are sometimes transferred to a younger successor, and this transfer is said to be made through a liaison of the two Thought Adjusters (114:7.10). As a result, the successor who receives these data may feel that he has lived on this planet before or has had previous experience here.

This is not reincarnation but a purposeful transfer of data. When A's experience and knowledge are needed by the successor B for an important planetary task, data from A's particular life are passed to B through contact between the Adjusters. B obtains the data needed for the task but may incidentally receive a strong feeling of having lived A's life. This is not the resolution of karma but a highly specialized handover.

4.4 Explanation 4: The Supreme Being

The deepest explanation involves the Supreme Being. If we do not choose to survive with the Adjuster, our personality loses its identity but not its experiential values.

Those values do not disappear; they continue as a factor in the personality of the Supreme Being. At the same time, our living minds evolve in direct contact with the cosmic mind.

Combining these two facts yields the following hypothesis. First, the experiential values (love, courage, the lessons of failure) of countless people throughout history who failed to survive have accumulated in the vast sea of experience that is the Supreme Being. Second, my mind is always connected with the Supreme Being through the cosmic mind. Third, in certain situations I may resonate strongly with this sea of collective experience. Fourth, I may mistake the echo of these collective, impersonal experiential values for my own very personal past life.

Therefore strong nostalgia for or memories of a particular era shared by many people (for example, Atlantis) may be not evidence of personal reincarnation but a resonance with collective experiential values preserved in the Supreme Being.

5. Conclusion: The Infinite Worth of a Single Personality and Cosmic Inheritance

The position of The Urantia Book is clear. Reincarnation, the recycling of personality, is clearly rejected. Melchizedek (94:2.3) regards it as a doctrine that robs mortals of hope; Jesus (130:2.8) regards the idea that a human soul passes into an animal as false; and anthropologically (86:4.6) it is regarded as a primitive misunderstanding.

The metaphor of refusing to go on to college (the mansion worlds) and endlessly repeating kindergarten (the material world) accurately captures the core of The Urantia Book's view that reincarnation is an inefficient and regressive system.

The alternative interpretations of past-life memories (the Adjuster, the angel, the reserve corps, the Supreme Being) present a view of the universe far more hopeful and refined than reincarnation. The universe of The Urantia Book is a universe that wastes nothing. A mortal's experience never disappears, even if he fails to survive. That experience is inherited by the Adjuster, kept by the angel, or accumulated in the Supreme Being.

In conclusion, the phenomenon of "past-life memories" may be evidence not of reincarnation but of a cosmic way of conserving experience that preserves forever even the unique experience of a single mortal and hands it on to the next generation. In the universe of The Urantia Book, personality is so sacred and unique that it can never be recycled, and experience is so precious that it is never thrown away.

q093.question: What does it mean that the ultimaton has Paradise as its nucleus?
q093.answer:
The phrase "the ultimaton has Paradise as its nucleus" means that the ultimaton, the most elementary energy unit of all physical matter existing in the universe, has the source of its existence, the central axis of its motion, and its gravitational control in the Isle of Paradise.
The specific meaning of this phrase is as follows.

1. The First Measurable Unit of Energy
Definition of the ultimaton: The ultimaton is "the first measurable form of physical energy particle" appearing in the process by which force-energy is materialized. These ultimatons are the primordial units that combine to make up subsequent particles such as the electron, and matter.
2. Response to the Absolute Gravity of Paradise
The central axis of revolution and motion: Ordinary atoms and matter respond to the pull of local gravity (linear gravity), but the ultimaton is not subject to the direct attraction between material bodies.
The ultimaton is wholly obedient only to the absolute gravity (circular gravity) exerted by the Isle of Paradise, and it revolves forever along the vast space circuits and elliptical paths of the master universe. In other words, when the ultimaton swings and moves through space, its absolute geographic and physical central axis (nucleus) is Paradise.
3. Dependence on the Energy Source and Pattern
Origin and maintenance: Matter and energy may appear to possess self-sufficient power, but the gravity lines of the energy involved in all physical phenomena derive from nether Paradise and are absolutely dependent on it.
Therefore, to say that the ultimaton has Paradise as its nucleus shows that even the most original particles of the physical universe are not independent products of chance but are firmly bound to and sustained by Paradise, the absolute physical source and gravity focus of all things.

In summary, the phrase expresses the cosmic physical structure in which the ultimaton, the most primordial energy particle of universe matter, is formed with Paradise as its center and is kept in orbit and sustained solely by the absolute gravity of Paradise.

q094.question: Shall we look in more detail at the metamorphosis by which ultimatons gather in groups of 100 to form an electron, and at the difference between the absolute gravity circuit of Paradise and linear gravity?
q094.answer:
Here are the specifics of the metamorphosis by which ultimatons form electrons and of the difference between the absolute gravity of Paradise and linear gravity.

1. The Metamorphosis by Which Ultimatons Form Electrons
The union of exactly 100: The ultimaton is the most primordial energy particle appearing in the stage of physical materialization [42:3.3]. When these ultimatons gather and are bound together by mutual attraction in groups of exactly 100, a typical electron is formed [42:6.5]. If even one of the 100 is lost, the identity of the typical electron is destroyed and it becomes a modified form [42:6.5].
The three inherent motions of the ultimaton: The ultimaton is not simply stationary within the electron but carries on three motions at the same time [42:6.4].
The motion of mutual resistance to cosmic force [42:6.4].
The individual axial revolution, which has antigravity potential [42:6.4].
The circuit-orbit motion that the 100 associated ultimatons carry on within the electron [42:6.4].
Intelligent control and environmental metamorphosis: When the Paradise force organizers have brought primordial force to the stage of energy that responds to gravity [15:4.1, 42:2.11, 42:2.12], the cold environment of space slows the activity of the ultimatons, producing conditions favorable to electronic assembly [42:4.5, 42:4.7]. At this point the Power Centers and Master Physical Controllers intervene and skillfully manipulate the revolutions and circuits of the ultimatons, finally transmuting them into electrical matter of the electronic level [42:4.3].

2. The Absolute Gravity of Paradise (Circular Gravity) vs. Linear Gravity (Local Gravity)
Center and origin / Absolute gravity of Paradise (circular gravity): nether Paradise [0:3.13, 11:8.1] / Linear gravity (local gravity): mass matter in space (electrons, atoms, etc.) [11:8.3, 42:6.2]
Mode of operation / Absolute gravity of Paradise (circular gravity): it swings energy along vast elliptical/circular paths throughout the whole master universe [12:1.1, 41:9.2]. / Linear gravity (local gravity): a short-range cohesive force by which material particles directly attract one another [42:11.5].
Objects acted upon / Absolute gravity of Paradise (circular gravity): all units of energy except space potency, ultimatons, and the whole of matter [11:8.2, 42:6.3]. / Linear gravity (local gravity): from the stage of atomic materialization onward, when matter has been organized into electrons and possesses mass [11:8.7, 42:6.2].
Characteristics and variables / Absolute gravity of Paradise (circular gravity): independent of time and space, absolute and unchanging under any conditions [11:8.1, 12:3.6]. / Linear gravity (local gravity): directly proportional to mass and inversely proportional to the square of the distance, and affected by space cushioning or antigravity [9:3.3, 11:8.3, 42:11.5].

The key difference: The ultimaton does not respond at all to linear gravity, by which nearby material bodies attract one another; it obeys only the circular absolute-gravity circuit exerted by the Isle of Paradise [41:9.2, 42:6.3]. Only after ultimatons have been bound together in groups of 100 to form electrons and have evolved into atomic systems does the linear gravity of space come fully into play [11:8.7, 42:6.2].

q095.question: Shall we also look at the decimal periodicity of the 100 chemical elements that appears when electrons constitute atoms, and at the principle of antigravity existing in space?
q095.answer:
1. The 100 Chemical Elements and Decimal Periodicity
The decimal structure of the physical universe: Whereas in the spiritual realm number systems such as 3, 7, and 12 are fundamental, the physical universe of matter and energy has a decimal structure (the number 10) inherently built into it.
A maximum of 100 chemical elements: In a local universe such as Nebadon, the atomic materialization of space energy, formed by electrons encircling a central proton nucleus, consists of a series of exactly 100 basic chemical elements, having from 1 to 100 orbital electrons. If one were artificially to try to introduce a 101st electron into the atomic orbital field, the central proton nucleus would immediately disrupt, and the energy would be violently scattered.
Electron zones and sevenfold periodicity: The outermost 10 electrons, belonging to the 10 heaviest elements, are highly independent and readily escape the grip of the atomic nucleus with changes in their environment (temperature or pressure). Moreover, the periodicity of the periodic table, in which chemical properties repeat every seven elements when the elements are arranged in order of atomic weight, is evidence of the persistence within the physical universe of the sevenfold structural nature originally possessed by the ancestral energies.

2. The Principle of Antigravity Existing in Space
The antigravity power of the Infinite Spirit: Antigravity is a unique and remarkable ability possessed by the Infinite Spirit, the Third Source and Center; within a local frame of space it serves to neutralize linear gravity (the force by which matter mutually attracts) and to counterbalance it equally.
Cosmic structural braking and cushioning: The structure in which the space levels of the master universe revolve in alternately opposite directions, and the cushioning action of pervaded space, exert antigravity effects that keep the pressure of material gravity from rising to destructive levels.
The action of the physical controllers and the ultimaton: Intelligences such as the power centers, mechanical controllers, and secondary dissociators possess considerable inherent antigravity endowment, by which they resist gravity and regulate the physical power equilibrium of the universe. In addition, the ultimaton itself, the most primordial energy particle, exhibits partial antigravity behavior by accelerating the velocity of its individual axial revolution.
The relation between heat and antigravity: In the universe, if gravity and cold (the absence of heat) serve to condense, organize, and hold matter together, heat and antigravity serve to disintegrate matter and to release and dissipate energy into space.

q096.question: An overview of the physical and spiritual principles of the universe energy system and atomic structure
q096.answer:
This report analyzes, from a hyper-physical point of view, the evolutionary metamorphosis of physical energy originating in nether Paradise and the ordering of atomic structure. It is stated at the outset that the terms "force," "energy," and "power" used in this text do not follow the definitions of ordinary modern physics but are described on the basis of the distinctive energy system and definitions of the source material provided (the Source Context).

1. The Origin of Universe Energy and Its Threefold Classification
All physical energy phenomena originate from the Unqualified Absolute and are classified into the following three stages according to their responsiveness to Paradise gravity and linear gravity.
Cosmic Force
Origin: The primordial state of energy, deriving from the Unqualified Absolute.
Physical characteristics: It is a potential form of physical reality but exists in a state that does not yet respond to Paradise gravity.
Emergent Energy
Origin: The "pre-electronic level" of energy-matter, evolved from cosmic force.
Physical characteristics: A transitional stage that begins to respond to Paradise gravity but does not yet respond to the local or linear gravity that acts on material mass.
Universe Power
Origin: The state in which emergent energy has fully entered the stage of materialization.
Physical characteristics: It signifies the "electronic level" of energy-matter and responds directly not only to Paradise gravity but also to material linear gravity. It becomes the foundation of all subsequent evolutionary materialization.
2. The Characteristics of the Ultimaton and the Process of Electron Formation
When energy-matter remains at the stage of "emergent energy," the "pre-electronic level," its basic unit is defined as the "ultimaton." The ultimaton possesses the distinctive physical property of being embraced by the Paradise gravity circuit while not responding to the linear gravity that acts on material mass. In accordance with the evolutionary laws of universe power, 100 ultimatons come together to form one electron, and at this point the energy undergoes a qualitative metamorphosis that goes beyond mere aggregation. Through this metamorphosis the electron at last enters the stage of "universe power," directly controlled by linear gravity, and acquires actual physical mass.
3. The Decimal Periodicity of the Chemical Elements and Cosmic Materialization
The evolution of matter that takes place at the stage of universe power is not a matter of random combination but the product of highly refined intelligent design.
The 100 chemical elements: The basic system of matter produced as the evolutionary result of universe power consists of 100 specific chemical elements. This is a key indicator showing that the process of materialization is controlled by cosmic order.
Decimal periodicity: These 100 elements are organized according to strict decimal periodicity. This systematic arrangement demonstrates that cosmic materialization is not a mere accumulation of universe power but the evolutionary result of materialization by intelligent design.
4. The Duality of the Gravity System: A Comparison of Absolute Gravity and Linear Gravity
The control of energy-matter in the universe is carried out through a dual gravity system with the Isle of Paradise as its point of origin.
Center/origin / Paradise absolute gravity: nether Paradise (the absolute center of energy-matter control) / Material linear gravity: material mass and the gravity centers of local universes
Objects of response / Paradise absolute gravity: ultimatons, electrons, and energy-matter in all its modified states / Material linear gravity: matter at or above the electronic level (universe power)
Physical characteristics / Paradise absolute gravity: a single static center unconditioned by time and space / Material linear gravity: proportional to mass and affected by spatial distance

※ Note: The Isle of Paradise, as the physical origin of the universe, has the unique physical paradox that it "has universe location but occupies no space," and it is the ultimate starting point of all gravity control.
5. The Infinite Spirit and the Principle of Antigravity
The Infinite Spirit, the Third Source and Center, as the "Conjoint Actor," unifies the power of mind and performs an "antigravity" function that overcomes the constraints of material gravity.
The mediating role of mind: The Infinite Spirit bestows the mind of the universe and, in personality, mediates between spirit and matter. Mind is not subject to the physical gravity circuit but responds directly to the "⟦Q 0:6.1⟧mind circuit of the Conjoint Actor⟦/Q⟧," thereby laying the foundation of its antigravity nature.
Transcending material limits: Mind bestowed by the Infinite Spirit is not directly governed by linear gravity, which is based on material mass. Mind is a living system superimposed upon physical energy, overcoming material constraints and advancing toward higher values.
Antigravity supercontrol: Through the power of mind, the Infinite Spirit co-ordinates physical energy and spiritual values. This is a ministry that maintains the unity of the whole universe by performing an "antigravity" function so that the universe does not sink into merely mechanistic physical laws.
6. Conclusion: An Integrated Understanding of Universe Reality
Energy, mind, and spirit, which make up the universe, appear to function on different levels, but ultimately they originate from a single source, Paradise.
All universe realities, whether personal or impersonal, are divinely co-ordinated. Space and pattern do not themselves respond to gravity, but gravity functions as the unique and absolute controller of all energy-matter. Reality originates in Paradise, is administered by gravity, and is organically unified through the mind ministry of the Infinite Spirit. As a result, all the physical laws and spiritual principles of the universe are brought to completion within one great unity.

q097.question: What are the roles of the living beings in charge of energy transformation?
q097.answer:
The four-stage cosmic metamorphosis by which the primordial potential of space passes through substantial matter until it is initiated as living life is as follows.

Stage 1: Space potency → primordial force (the primary eventuated master force organizers)
Space potency (absoluta): Space that appears to be empty is filled with "space potency," the pre-reality space presence of the Unqualified Absolute.
Triggering by passive presence: The primary eventuated master force organizers, who originate in Paradise, intervene in this inactive field. At this stage the master force organizers do not apply any direct action; merely by providing their passive presence and tension resistance, they act as the sole triggering mechanism that transmutes space potency into "primordial force" (segregata, or pure energy).
Stage 2: Primordial force → emergent energy → gravity energy (the associate transcendental master force organizers)
The formation of energy cyclones: When the primary force organizers stir up enormous whirls (cyclones) of force in the space field, primordial force develops into primary emergent energy (emergent energy, the first phase of ultimata), marked by powerful directionality and mass movement.
Refinement into the gravity stage: At this point the associate transcendental master force organizers take over and, by applying powerful tensions and pressures, refine the energy into the stage of secondary gravity energy (the second phase of ultimata).
The withdrawal of the organizers: When this energy at last responds directly to the circular absolute gravity of Paradise and acquires a potential responsiveness to the linear gravity that will later appear (gravity between material masses), the associate force organizers withdraw from the energy cyclone and move on to the next outer space.
Stage 3: Gravity energy → universe power and the transmutation into matter (the universe power directors)
Materialization and linear gravity: In the place vacated by the associate force organizers, the universe power directors of the superuniverse regime and the master physical controllers appear. They slow down, condense, and combine space energies, transmuting them into universe power (gravita), directly subject to linear gravity, and into physical matter on the electronic and atomic levels.
Control of twenty-one phases of energy: The whole physical energy charge that pervades the seven superuniverses consists of 30 phases, and the universe power controllers, including the mechanical controllers, fully manage and intelligently manipulate twenty-one of these thirty phases, stabilizing stars, planets, and circuits.
Stage 4: Nonliving matter → the initiation of life (the Life Carriers and the universe Mother Spirit)
Organizing the material pattern: When things have been physically settled and the planetary environment has been prepared, the Life Carriers are dispatched to combine nonliving elements and energies and to design and organize the electrochemical formulas and structure of life plasm.
The imparting of the living spark: Although the Life Carriers play the refined role of catalyzing the physical forms and the plasm, the essential provider who breathes the actual living spark (the breath of life) and the prophecy of mind into the inert material organism is the local universe Mother Spirit (the local universe Creative Spirit). Through the combination of this threefold ministry, life that reproduces itself autonomously and experiences at last begins within nonliving matter.

q098.question: Please give me the textbook explanations of the electron, the quantum, the neutron, the atom, and the element, with their characteristics and relationships.
q098.answer:
1. Definitions and Characteristics of Each Concept
Element
Definition: A kind (constituent) of matter that cannot be broken down further by chemical means (for example, hydrogen, oxygen, carbon, iron).
Characteristics: Its kind is determined by the number of protons in the atomic nucleus (the atomic number), and its properties recur with a regular periodicity in the periodic table.
Atom
Definition: The smallest physical and chemical unit of particle that makes up an element.
Characteristics: It consists of a dense atomic nucleus at the center and electrons circling around it, a structure resembling a solar system.
Proton vs. Quantum
Proton: A positively (+) charged particle that makes up the atomic nucleus. It is about 2,000 times heavier than the negatively (-) charged electron, and the number of protons is the atomic number of the atom and determines the kind of element.
Quantum: Not the name of a particle but the basic physical unit of energy, meaning that energy is absorbed or emitted in discontinuous minimal packets. (In Korean textbooks and everyday usage the word for "proton" is sometimes shortened to the word for "quantum," but as a physical concept the quantum is the minimal unit of energy.)
Neutron
Definition: A particle carrying no electric charge (neutral) that exists in the atomic nucleus together with the protons.
Characteristics: Among the protons, whose positive (+) charges repel one another, it binds the nucleus together so that it does not break apart, maintaining the stability of the atomic nucleus.
Electron
Definition: A minute, negatively (-) charged particle that revolves at high speed around the atomic nucleus.
Characteristics: It is extremely light, about 1/2,000 of the weight of the hydrogen atom, the lightest atom, and the movement and revolution of the outer electrons of the atom give rise to the chemical reactions and electrical phenomena of matter.

2. Their Organic Relationship
Macroscopic kind and microscopic particle: An element is the name denoting a chemical kind of matter, and the actual particle unit that makes up this element is the atom.
The internal structure of the atom: At the center of the atom lies the atomic nucleus, which is made up of protons and neutrons strongly bound together.
The motion of the electrons: In the outer orbits around the atomic nucleus, the electrons revolve.
The transfer of energy (the quantum): When an electron moves between orbits or absorbs or emits energy, the energy is transferred not as a continuous flow but in specific unit packets called quanta

q099.question: Please explain simply the definitions of and relationships among absolute mind, cosmic mind, infinite mind, adjutant spirit mind, morontia mind, and so on.
q099.answer:
The various dimensions of "mind" spoken of in The Urantia Book form a cosmic hierarchy through which intelligence (wisdom) flows down from Paradise, the divine source of all things, to evolving human beings, and through which it ascends again [9:4.3, 17:7.1, 42:10.5].
The definitions of these five principal kinds of mind and their mutual relationships are as follows.

1. Infinite Mind / Absolute Mind
Definition: The mind of the Infinite Spirit, the third person of Deity, the absolute source and ancestor of the intelligence existing in all the universes [9:1.1, 9:4.2].
Characteristics: It completely transcends the limitations of time and space and is infinite and absolute [9:4.4]. It is the foundation of all the mind circuits existing in the universes [9:4.3].
2. Cosmic Mind
Definition: The subabsolute, finite intelligence that becomes active when the infinite mind descends to the level of the grand universe (the seven superuniverses) [9:4.3, 16:6.1]. It is distributed throughout the whole grand universe by way of the Seven Master Spirits of Paradise [9:4.3, 16:6.1].
Characteristics: It is time-conditioned and co-ordinates matter and spirit in the zone between the two [9:4.4, 9:4.7]. It endows will creatures such as human beings with three a priori cosmic intuitions, science (causation), morality (duty), and religion (worship), helping them to think rationally [16:6.6, 16:6.7, 16:6.8].
3. Adjutant Mind-Spirits (adjutant spirit mind)
Definition: The seven graded subordinate mind circuits that the local universe Mother Spirit (the Divine Minister), who presides over each local universe, bestows upon the material living beings of the evolutionary planets [17:7.1, 36:5.1].
The seven adjutant spirits: They consist of the spirits of intuition, understanding, courage, knowledge, counsel, worship, and wisdom [34:4.10, 36:5.6, 36:5.12].
Characteristics: Beginning with the primitive reflex instincts of animals, they progressively develop intelligence [36:5.6, 36:5.12]. Only when evolving humans respond to the sixth (worship) and seventh (wisdom) adjutants do they gain the capacity for moral choice and become qualified to receive the indwelling Thought Adjuster (a fragment of the spirit of God) and to grow an immortal soul [34:5.3, 36:5.12].
4. Morontia Mind
Definition: The transitional mind between matter and spirit that human beings possess when, having finished the life in the flesh, they pass through the mansion worlds after death and the ascension stages of the local universe [12:8.7, 42:10.5, 110:2.6].
Characteristics: It co-ordinates and unifies material logic and spiritual mota [47:5.3, 103:6.7], and it mediates the ascending mortal's gradual rise to the status of pure spirit through 570 successive transformations [48:1.5].

💡 Their organic relationship at a glance
Paradise source: infinite mind (absolute mind) [Infinite Spirit] ↓ (distributed to the superuniverses by way of the Seven Master Spirits) [9:4.3]
Grand universe intelligence circuit: cosmic mind [Seven Master Spirits] ↓ (bestowed upon the planets by way of the local universe Mother Spirit) [34:4.10, 36:5.1]
Evolutionary planet/human level: adjutant mind-spirits [the seven adjutant spirits] ↓ (forming the immortal soul through worship and wisdom and ascending after death) [34:5.3, 36:5.12]
Transitional ascension level: morontia mind [the 570-stage morontia intelligence linking matter and spirit] [48:1.5]
In other words, the intelligence of the universe, springing from the absolute mind of the Infinite Spirit, is concretized step by step as cosmic mind and adjutant spirit mind to awaken material humankind, and spiritually awakened human beings, passing through morontia mind, ascend once more toward God in Paradise, thus forming a cosmic cycle of relationship [9:4.3, 36:5.1, 42:10.5].

q100.question: What is midwayer intellect? Does it mean that there are two more levels above the seven adjutant mind-spirits?
q100.answer:
1. The Meaning of "Midwayers" and "Midwayer Intellect"

Midwayers (midway creatures): Planetary creatures who exist in an intermediate position between the material humans (mortals) of the evolutionary planets and the nonmaterial angels (seraphim), and who serve invisibly [37:9.11, 38:9.2, 77:0.1].

Midwayer intellect: It means the superhuman intelligence that the secondary midway creatures put into operation by receiving the ministry of the two highest of the seven adjutant mind-spirits, the sixth, "⟦Q 38:9.6⟧the spirit of worship⟦/Q⟧," and the seventh, "⟦Q 38:9.6⟧the spirit of wisdom⟦/Q⟧," [38:9.6, 38:9.7].

2. Three Levels of Intellect according to How the Adjutants Are Received

The seven adjutant mind-spirits of the local universe Mother Spirit (intuition, understanding, courage, knowledge, counsel, worship, wisdom) are used as follows according to the evolutionary level of the creature [36:5.2, 42:10.4].

Animal intellect (subhuman level):

It responds only to the first five of the seven adjutants (the spirits of intuition, understanding, courage, knowledge, and counsel) and carries on instinctive and learned survival activities [36:5.6-5.10, 42:10.4].

Human intellect (moral level):

It responds to all seven adjutants (1 through 7) [34:5.3, 42:10.4]. In particular, by responding to the sixth (worship) and seventh (wisdom) adjutants, it gains the capacity for moral choice and the spiritual potential of knowing God [34:5.3, 36:5.11-5.12].

Midwayer intellect (superhuman level):

It responds to "the last two" of the seven adjutants (the sixth, the spirit of worship + the seventh, the spirit of wisdom) together with the joint ministry of the morontia transition mind, and carries out high-level planetary administration and spiritual auxiliary tasks [38:9.6, 38:9.7, 42:10.4].

In summary, it does not mean that two more spirits exist above the seven; it means the superhuman level of intellect that the midway creatures manifest by utilizing "the last two" of the seven adjutants (worship and wisdom) [38:9.6, 38:9.7, 42:10.4].

q101.question: What is the chronology from the Andronover nebula to the initiation of life?
q101.answer:
987 billion years ago: An associate force organizer of Orvonton reports the possibility of materialization in the region of the Andronover nebula.

900 billion years ago: The Uversa Council of Equilibrium dispatches force organizers and authorizes the creation of the nebula.

875 billion years ago: The Andronover nebula (No. 876,926) is officially initiated, and the energy whirl begins.

800 billion years ago: The Andronover primary nebular stage is established.

700 billion years ago: The condensation of the nebula proceeds, and additional physical controllers are dispatched.

600 billion years ago: The energy aggregation of the Andronover nebula reaches its peak, attaining maximum mass.

500 billion years ago: The first Andronover sun is born (the primary sun ejections begin).

400 billion years ago: Michael, the Creator Son of Nebadon, chooses the nebular region and begins building the headquarters.

300 billion years ago: The Uversa government gives physical recognition to the local universe of Nebadon.

200 billion years ago: The central Andronover cluster condenses, and the Nebadon universe machinery goes into operation.

100 billion years ago: The Andronover nebula reaches its maximum of heat tension.

75 billion years ago: The period of primary sun ejections reaches its height.

50 billion years ago: The primary sun dispersion is completed (876,926 solar systems born).

25 billion years ago: The third nebular cycle is completed, and the stellar systems are stabilized.

10 billion years ago: The fourth cycle of the Andronover nebula begins.

8 billion years ago: The secondary sun ejections and the final explosions of the nebula begin.

7 billion years ago: The terminal breakup of Andronover reaches its climax.

6 billion years ago: The Andronover nebula comes to its end, and the sun (the central sun of Monmatia) is born.

5 billion years ago: The sun (Monmatia) becomes isolated and enters a state of variable pulsation.

4.5 billion years ago: The approach of the Angona system draws out the material of the twelve planets (the birth of the solar system).

4 billion years ago: The Jupiter and Saturn systems are formed, and the capture of meteorites evolves.

3.5 billion years ago: The cores of the ten planets of the solar system and of the satellites are formed (the age of planetary assembly).

3 billion years ago: The solar system is entered under the name "Monmatia" on the physical registry of Nebadon.

2.5 billion years ago: The primitive sphere of Urantia develops (one tenth of its present mass).

2 billion years ago: The earth and the moon separate; the volcanic age and the formation of the primitive atmosphere.

1.5 billion years ago: Urantia reaches two thirds of its present size, and volcanic activity reaches its height.

1 billion years ago: The crust cools, a worldwide primitive ocean forms, and the name "Urantia" is registered.

950 million years ago: A single continent and the Pacific Ocean are formed, and the planet is assigned to the system of Satania.

900 million years ago: A Satania survey party visits, and the planet is designated a decimal life-experiment planet.

850 million years ago: The crust enters its first era of stabilization.

800 million years ago: The era of increasing continental emergence begins.

750 million years ago: The first north-south continental cleavage occurs.

700 million years ago: Continental drift, and the preparation of an environment favorable to life.

650 million years ago: The continental seas expand, and the salinity of the oceans develops.

600 million years ago: The commission of Life Carriers makes its first survey and investigation of Urantia.

550 million years ago: The corps of Life Carriers implants life in three marine regions, and life is first initiated.

q102.question: Please tell me in detail about the three life-implantation sites in The Urantia Book, the circumstances, and the developments that followed.
q102.answer:
The three life-implantation sites of Urantia (the earth) described in The Urantia Book, the circumstances at the time, and the subsequent course of evolutionary development are as follows.

1. The Background of Life Implantation and the Environmental Conditions

Designation as a decimal experimental planet: Urantia is the 606th inhabited world of the system of Satania and also a decimal planet (a life-experiment planet), one out of every ten being so designated [49:0.3, 58:0.1]. It is a sphere on which experiments modifying and improving the standard universe life designs are permitted [58:0.1].

Physical and chemical preparation: About 600 million years ago a commission of Life Carriers sent from Jerusem surveyed the environment of Urantia [58:1.1]. Because protoplasm of the Urantia type can function only in a suitable saline solution, they waited until the salinity of the inland seas had reached the proper level and shallow tropical bays and lagoons had formed [58:1.3, 58:1.6-1.7].

2. The Three Life-Implantation Sites and the Circumstances at the Time

The time of implantation: About 550 million years ago, the corps of Life Carriers returned and, in co-operation with supermaterial and spiritual forces, planted the original marine life patterns native to the earth [58:4.2, 58:4.5].

The implantation sites: Life was implanted simultaneously in three places in the central sea that divided east and west the great continental mass then breaking up, that is, in warm, shallow, sheltered tropical inlets (protected waters) [58:4.2, 58:4.4, 65:2.1, 65:2.13].

Central region: Eurasia-Africa [58:4.2]

Eastern region: Australasia (the Australian and Antarctic group) [58:4.2]

Western region: Greenland and the Americas [58:4.2]

The purpose of the implantation: The protoplasm planted in the three regions was an original and identical life implantation, and the purpose was to ensure that, when the great continents later drifted and separated completely, each continent would carry this life with it in its warm waters [58:4.2, 58:4.4].

3. The Stage-by-Stage Development after Life Implantation

① The establishment of plant life and the transition to animals (500 to 450 million years ago)

By 500 million years ago primitive marine vegetation was well established [58:4.3], and 450 million years ago, in the shallow seas and lagoons of the separating continents, the gradual transition from plant to animal took place [58:6.1]. Sponges and the like appeared at this time as borderline transitional organisms [65:2.2].

② The appearance of multicellular animals and trilobites (400 million years ago / the Cambrian)

400 million years ago the trilobites, the first multicellular animals, suddenly evolved and dominated the seas [59:1.4]. The characteristics of animals originating from the three implantation regions began to show slightly different regional features among the Western Hemisphere, Eurasian, and Australasian groups [59:1.14].

③ The appearance of vertebrates (fishes), amphibians, reptiles, and mammals

Fishes (250 million years ago): The fishes, the first vertebrates, appeared in the northern seas [59:4.9-4.10].

Amphibians (210 million years ago): As the swim bladders of primitive arthropods that crawled out of the sea onto the land evolved into lungs, air-breathing amphibians such as frogs appeared [59:5.5-5.6]. The frog is one of the oldest land-vertebrate ancestors of humankind that have survived to the present day [65:2.7].

Reptiles and mammals (140 to 50 million years ago): After the age of reptiles (dinosaurs), the placental mammals suddenly appeared 50 million years ago from agile, leaping dinosaur ancestors [60:1.9, 61:0.1, 61:1.2, 65:2.12].

4. The Fate of the Three Life Lines and the Final Appearance of Humankind

The lines that started from the three life-implantation sites met different fates over time, as follows.

The limitations of the eastern implantation line: The organisms of the eastern life implantation at first developed favorably up to the prehuman level, but when the highest types of germ plasm suffered repeated and irretrievable losses, they lost their potential for intellectual development and their growth was limited [65:2.13-2.14].

The union of the western and central lines:

The higher mammals (the lemur stock) that were to become the direct ancestors of humankind developed most excellently chiefly from the western life implantation (North America) [62:0.1, 65:2.13, 65:2.15].

This western line crossed the Bering land bridge and migrated southwest along the coast of Asia [62:1.2, 65:2.15].

In the paradisiacal environment west of India (the Mesopotamian/Persian peninsula), the line of western origin and the superior line of the central life implantation united to form the final ancestral human line [62:0.1, 62:1.2, 65:2.15].

The appearance of the first human beings (Andon and Fonta) (about one million years ago):

About one million years ago (exactly 993,419 years ago), Andon and Fonta, the first true human beings, were born of primate twins isolated in southwestern Asia [62:5.1, 62:5.2, 63:0.1].

When, at about the age of ten, they responded to the adjutant mind-spirits of worship and wisdom and made volitional choices, Urantia was at last registered in the universe of Nebadon as an official inhabited planet peopled by will creatures [62:6.5, 62:7.3, 62:7.7].

q103.question: The specific circumstances by which the earth and the other planets were ejected from the sun when the Angona system approached 4.5 billion years ago, and the nuclear reactions taking place within the sun and the role of the element calcium
q103.answer:
The specific details of how the solar system was born through the approach of the Angona system about 4.5 billion years ago, and of the nuclear reactions within the sun and the cosmic role of the element calcium, are as follows.

1. The Approach of the Angona System 4.5 Billion Years Ago and the Birth of the Solar System (Monmatia)

The approach of the Angona system: About 4.5 billion years ago the Angona system, an enormous dark giant of space, solid and highly charged, began to approach our sun, which was then isolated.

Tidal convulsions and the ejection of a gas column: At that time the sun was in a state of variable-star pulsation, swelling and contracting on a three-and-a-half-day cycle, and so was very sensitive to outside gravitational stimuli. As Angona drew steadily nearer over some 500,000 years, enormous tongues of solar gas were ejected into space at each moment of the sun's maximum expansion during its pulsations.

The formation of the twelve planets: When Angona made its closest approach, enormous tidal extrusions took place on both sides of the sun. The gas drawn out toward Angona was permanently detached from the sun in the form of a gigantic gas column, pointed at both ends and bulging in the middle.

From the condensation nuclei at the two tapering ends of the gas column, five inner planets and five outer planets were formed.

From the bulging middle portion came the giant planets Jupiter and Saturn, and for a time after their formation these two planets functioned like secondary suns, giving off their own light.

The capture of foreign bodies and retrograde motion: By its powerful gravity the sun wrested three bodies belonging to the Angona system and included them in its own planetary family. Collisions of bodies during this process introduced the exceptional phenomenon of retrograde motion (clockwise revolution/rotation) among the bodies of the solar system.

The characteristics of the orbital plane: The reason the planets of the solar system revolve not in the plane of the sun's equator but along an inclined plane is likewise that the planets were drawn out not by the sun's rotation but along the plane of the solar extrusion formed at the time of Angona's approach.

2. The Nuclear Reactions within the Sun and the Role of the Element Calcium

The solar interior at 35 million degrees and its nuclear reactions: The temperature at the center of the sun reaches about 35 million degrees Fahrenheit (℉) and generates enormous X rays. Under this high temperature and pressure, intact atoms cannot exist and are broken down into subatomic particles.

The most common mechanism of solar energy release is the hydrogen-carbon-helium reaction.

The carbon nucleus can hold up to four protons; when hydrogen particles penetrate the carbon nucleus and saturate it, it releases them in the form of a helium atom. In this process the carbon itself is not used up but serves as an energy catalyst converting hydrogen into helium.

The acrobatic escape mechanism of the element calcium:

Calcium is the basic building material of space and the planets (stone dust), most abundantly permeating the whole space of the superuniverse of Orvonton.

Although the calcium atom is a relatively heavy particle with 20 electrons, it is the "expert solar jail-breaker," the best at escaping through the sun's powerful gravity into space.

The acrobatics of the electrons: After losing one of its outer electrons, the calcium atom performs an amazing acrobatic feat, throwing its nineteenth electron back and forth between the nineteenth and twentieth orbits some 25,000 times a second.

Through this delicate electronic motion the calcium atom partially defies gravity and escapes out of the sun by riding the stream of light and energy, catching and letting go of the solar rays 25,000 times a second.

Because of this calcium escape activity, a layer of gaseous calcium (stone) some 6,000 miles thick is formed at the surface of the sun.

q104.question: What does The Urantia Book mean when it says there are twelve planets in the Monmatia solar system? Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto makes only nine.
q104.answer:
When The Urantia Book explains that there were twelve planets in Monmatia (the solar system), it refers to the number of basic planets that were born by condensing directly from the column of primordial gas ejected from the sun when the Angona system approached about 4.5 billion years ago.

The reasons this differs from the familiar structure of nine planets (eight officially today), "Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto," are as follows.

1. The Formation Structure of the Original Twelve Planets (5 + 2 + 5)

The enormous column of solar gas drawn out of the sun by the gravitational pull of Angona was slender at both ends and swollen in the middle.

The giant planets in the middle (2): From the most swollen central portion of the column came the giant planets Jupiter and Saturn.

The inner and outer planets (10): From the condensation nuclei at the tapering ends of the column on either side, five inner planets and five outer planets were formed respectively.

In this way a total of twelve original planets were assembled from the gas column of the primitive solar system.

2. The Vanished "Fifth Planet" and the Asteroid Belt

Why, then, are there not twelve today? According to The Urantia Book, it is because one of the twelve planets was destroyed in a cosmic catastrophe.

The disruption of the fifth planet: The fifth planet of the solar system, which lay between Mars and Jupiter, traveled in an irregular orbit and periodically came closer and closer to Jupiter.

Finally, when it reached the critical point of Jupiter's powerful gravity-tidal disruption limit, this fifth planet was suddenly shattered to pieces.

The fragments of this destroyed fifth planet came to form the asteroid belt that today circles in the orbit between Mars and Jupiter.

3. The Capture of Bodies from the Angona System

In addition, at the time of its formation the solar system wrested by gravity three foreign bodies (planets) from the approaching Angona system and added them to its own planetary family. As an aftereffect of these collisions and captures, the phenomenon of retrograde motion, revolving or rotating in a clockwise direction, was introduced into some bodies of the solar system.

💡 Summary

Modern science has traditionally counted nine planets (eight officially since the reclassification of Pluto in 2006) and regards the asteroid belt as merely a cluster of rocks, but The Urantia Book explains things on the basis of the structure of twelve fundamental planets born from the primordial solar gas column, including the "fifth planet" that was shattered into the asteroid belt.

q105.question: It is said that the nuclear remnant of the mother nebula still gives light and heat to its remnant planetary family of 165 worlds (57:4.9). What does "165 worlds" refer to?
q105.answer:
The "165 worlds" appearing in Paper 57, Section 4, paragraph 9 of The Urantia Book do not mean the earth or the planets of our solar system (Monmatia); they refer to the 165 remnant planets that still revolve directly around the central nuclear remnant of the Andronover nebula, the mother body that produced our sun [57:1.1, 57:4.9].

The specific cosmic background and meaning are as follows.

1. The Andronover Nebula and the Birth of the Suns

Over long ages of contraction and rotation, the Andronover nebula threw out into space, in two generations (the primary and secondary ejections), a total of 1,013,628 suns ("lords of light") and made them independent [57:4.3, 57:4.8, 57:4.9].

About 6 billion years ago, in the course of the secondary terminal disruptions of the Andronover nebula, our sun was born as the 1,013,572nd sun and left the nebula to become independent [57:4.8].

2. The Identity of the "Nuclear Remnant of the Mother Nebula" and the "165 Worlds"

After more than a million suns had been ejected, the "terminal nuclear remnant" that remained last at the center of the nebula did not vanish completely but remained as a single central body glowing with a reddish light [57:4.9].

The last planetary family, which has not escaped the gravitational domain of this venerable nuclear remnant of the mother nebula but remains as its offspring, revolving around that center to this day, consists of the 165 worlds (planets) [57:4.9].

This nuclear remnant of the mother nebula still sustains the 165 remnant planets that it directly holds by emitting a gentle light and heat to them [57:4.9].

In summary, the expression refers to "the central nucleus of the Andronover mother nebula," which gave birth to more than a million suns and is now cooling with a red glow, and to "the last 165 planetary family members" held directly by that center and still revolving around it [57:4.8, 57:4.9].

q106.question: From the lemur to the first human beings, how did humans come into being?
q106.answer:
According to The Urantia Book, humans are not a mere product of chance or a direct transformation from the apes; they came into being about a million years ago through three successive and sudden mutations that began in the North American lemur stock.

The specific process from the lemurs to the appearance of Andon and Fonta, the first human beings, is as follows.

1. The Early Lemurs and the Migration to Southwestern Asia

The origin in the North American lemur type: About 50 million years ago, in the age of mammals, placental mammals of the lemur type evolved in North America. They were not the direct ancestors of the modern lemurs; both branched off from a common ancient ancestor.

Migration to Asia and isolation: The North American lemurs crossed the Bering land bridge, moved southwestward along the coast of Asia, and reached the pleasant highlands west of India (the present Mesopotamian/Persian peninsula). Later, as the surrounding coasts were submerged, they were isolated in this utopian region, and here, by uniting with the superior stock of the central life implantation, they formed the ancestral line of humankind.

2. The First Mutation: The Dawn Mammals

Appearance (a little more than a million years ago): In the seventieth generation of the lemur ancestors, the first mutation, the dawn mammals, suddenly appeared.

Physical and behavioral characteristics: They were about 3 feet (about 90 cm) tall and could easily stand erect, though not habitually. They were hairy and agile and relished meat.

Characteristics of the hands and feet: They had an opposable thumb (a thumb able to grasp objects) and a grasping big toe. (From this point on, the human line continued to develop the thumb and lost the grasping function of the toe, while the apes retained the grasping toe but failed to develop the thumb.)

Intelligence and emotions: They had the largest brain in proportion to body size, developed curiosity, conceit, fear, tribal spirit, and pugnacity in defending the home, and built rough shelters in the tops of tall trees to escape the dangers of the ground.

3. The Second Mutation: The Mid-Mammals and the Divergence from the Apes

Appearance (70 generations after the dawn mammals): In the treetop shelter of a superior pair of dawn mammals, twins, a brother and a sister (a male and a female), were born, and with them the mid-mammals began.

Physical characteristics: They grew to over 4 feet (about 120 cm) in height, had almost no hair on their bodies, and their legs lengthened while their arms shortened, so that they became fully adapted to upright walking. Their hands had an almost fully opposable thumb.

Way of life: Displaying constructive tendencies, they built not only treetop shelters but also underground shelters in the form of tunnels. They had the habit of collecting smooth, round pebbles for use as weapons or for defense.

The divergence of the apes and the human line:

While the mid-mammal group was flourishing greatly, two pairs of twins were born at the same time.

The inferior twins: They shunned hunting and meat-eating and went off to the tropical fruit regions of the south, and their descendants became the modern simian tribes (monkeys, baboons, chimpanzees, gorillas).

The superior twins: They formed the ascending line leading to humankind. (In other words, The Urantia Book makes clear that humans did not evolve from the apes but are the descendants of different twins who branched off from a common ancestor, the mid-mammals.)

4. The Third Mutation: The Primates

Appearance (while the mid-mammals were flourishing): In a crisis in which lightning struck a tree, a leading pair of mid-mammals migrated to another region, and from them superior twins, a brother and a sister, were born, with whom the primate species appeared.

Physical and intellectual characteristics: They were over 5 feet (about 150 cm) tall and walked fully erect from just after birth. Their heads were larger and they had less hair, and the structure of their hands and feet was completed in the human pattern.

Language and migration: At about fourteen years of age they went west and set up a home, founding the primate species, and they communicated by gestures and vocal symbols. They lived mainly on the ground, but at night they slept in the trees for safety.

5. The Birth of the First True Human Beings: Andon and Fonta

Time of birth: About 21,000 years (about 900 generations) after the origin of the primates, twins Andon and Fonta, the first two true human beings, were born of a primate pair. (Exactly 993,419 years before A.D. 1934, that is, about a million years ago.)

Physical characteristics: They had a fully human type of thumb and foot structure, and they mainly walked and ran rather than climbing trees. They matured at twelve, and their potential life span was about 75 years.

New human emotions and decisions:

In addition to sympathy, shame, love, and jealousy, the "worshipful emotions" such as awe, reverence, humility, and gratitude appeared for the first time.

By about the age of ten they had developed a language of gestures and sounds conveying fifty ideas, and they voluntarily decided to break away from their inferior animal relatives and migrate northward.

Andon and Fonta were the first to invent a way of making fire for themselves by striking flint sparks into a dry bird's nest.

6. Mental and Spiritual Significance and Cosmic Recognition

The operation of the adjutant mind-spirits:

From the lemurs to the primates, only the first five adjutant spirits (intuition, understanding, courage, knowledge, counsel) functioned, at the level of the animal mind.

When Andon and Fonta reached the age of ten, the sixth adjutant spirit, "the spirit of worship," made contact with their minds for the first time in the history of Urantia.

At about eleven years of age, when they made the voluntary choice to flee northward with purpose, the seventh adjutant spirit, "the spirit of wisdom," began to function.

Registration as an inhabited world: As soon as the human mind endowed with will appeared, a communication circuit to the capital of the universe of Nebadon (Salvington) was automatically established, and Urantia was officially registered in the universe as the 606th inhabited planet of the system of Satania.

The indwelling of the Thought Adjusters: Andon and Fonta received divine Thought Adjusters (fragments of the spirit of God) as a gift, and after death, passing through the mansion worlds, they became immortal beings who survive eternally

q107.question: How did the primitive civilization of the Andonic clans and the six colored races (the Sangik races) appear?
q107.answer:
1. The Nineteen Children of Andon and Fonta, the First Humans, and the Early Primitive Civilization of the "Andonic Clans"

① The first family and the nineteen children

The first child, Sontad: Two years after they had fled north from the primate tribe, Sontad, the first child of Andon and Fonta, was born. Sontad was the first baby born on Urantia (the earth) to be wrapped in a protective covering (a cloth) at birth.

Children and dwelling place: Andon and Fonta had nineteen children in all, and they enjoyed seeing some fifty grandchildren and six great-grandchildren. The family lived together in four half-cave shelters dug out of limestone with flint tools and connected by passageways.

The death of Andon and Fonta: In their forty-second year, Andon and Fonta lost their lives, together with five of their children and eleven grandchildren, when a violent earthquake brought down the overhanging limestone rock. Their eldest son, Sontad, though injured, became the leader of the clan and buried his parents and family by heaping up a mound of stones.

② The characteristics of the primitive civilization of the Andonic clans

Physical characteristics and clothing: They had dark eyes and a swarthy skin (melanin pigment) mixed with a slight tinge of yellow and red, and in appearance they most closely resembled the modern Eskimos. To endure the cold, they were the first in the history of the earth to make and wear clothing of animal skins.

The invention of artificial fire: Striking flints, Andon sent sparks flying into a discarded dry bird's nest and so kindled the first artificial fire in the history of the earth. Thanks to fire, they were able to overcome the cold northern environment and become completely independent of their inferior animal relatives to the south.

The invention of tools and hunting: Andon invented the "stone ax (hammer)" by binding a piece of flint to a club with animal tendons, and his descendants discovered and used the throwing stick and the harpoon. They lived a hunting life, eating nothing but the meat they hunted, apart from wild fruits.

Language and clan culture: They developed a language of gestures and sounds conveying about fifty ideas, and they coined new words daily in keeping with new inventions and adaptations. Their friendship and clan consciousness were very strong and their love of their children was exceptional, but they had no sense of humor and no hearty laughter. (Humor was a later legacy brought by the Adamic race.)

Onagar and the first spiritual revival: Tens of thousands of years after the appearance of Andon, Onagar (born about 983,323 years ago), the first great teacher, appeared. He ended the wars among the clans and trained the first missionaries, who spread the worship of "the Breath Giver" (God) and the teaching of the afterlife ("the Great Beyond"). He was also the first to teach the cooking of meat by roasting it over the fire.

2. How the Six Colored Races (the Sangik Races) Appeared 500,000 Years Ago

① The background of their appearance: The terrible wars of the Badonan tribes

The Badonan tribes: Of the line of a great-great-grandson of Andon, they lived in the highlands of northwestern India and were superior Andonite descendants who did not offer human sacrifices.

The hundred-year racial war: About 500,000 years ago a ruthless racial war broke out among the highland Badonan tribes and lasted more than a hundred years; when the war ended, only a hundred families of superior survivors remained.

② The simultaneous mutation in one family (the Sangik family)

The nineteen Sangik children: To one surviving Badonan couple were born nineteen Sangik children, who were unusually intelligent and whose skins took on different colors from one another when exposed to sunlight.

The first exceptional event in the system of Satania: On an ordinary evolutionary planet the six colored races appear one after another, from the red to the indigo race, over hundreds of thousands of years, but on Urantia they appeared simultaneously as nineteen children in one family.

The proportion of skin colors: Five red, two orange, four yellow, two green, four blue, and two indigo children were born.

③ The characteristics and historical course of the six colored races

The red man (a primary race): The most intelligent of the Sangiks, they were the first to develop civilization and government and adhered to monogamy. After wars with the yellow man they crossed the Bering land bridge, migrated to the American continent, and were isolated there (great leader: Onamonalonton).

The orange man (a secondary race): They had a strong and peculiar urge to build, heaping up great piles of stones and mounds, but after migrating to Africa they fought a hundred-year war with the green race and were the first to be completely exterminated, about 100,000 years ago (leader: Porshunta).

The yellow man (a primary race): They were the first to give up hunting and to establish agriculture and settled homes, and they excelled in solidarity and social co-operation. They occupied eastern Asia and formed what is today Chinese civilization (leader: Singlangton).

The green man (a secondary race): They included a giant strain reaching 8 to 9 feet in height, but they were somewhat inferior in ability. They scattered in three branches and, after destroying the orange race, were finally absorbed into the indigo race and disappeared (leader: Fantad).

The blue man (a primary race): They invented the spear and excelled in art and toolmaking. They migrated to Europe, absorbed the Neanderthals, and became the Cro-Magnons, and later, uniting with the violet race (the Adamites), became the chief biological foundation of the modern white (Caucasoid) peoples (leader: Orlandof).

The indigo man (a secondary race / the black race): Of the Sangiks they were the last to leave their homeland, and they took possession of the whole African continent (leader: Orvonon).

q108.question: What were the Planetary Prince Caligastia and his staff, and the civilization of Dalamatia, like?
q108.answer:
1. The Arrival of the Planetary Prince Caligastia and His Staff of One Hundred

The background and purpose of the arrival: About 500,000 years ago, when the population of the earth had reached about half a billion, Caligastia, a secondary Lanonandek Son, was sent as the Planetary Prince of Urantia. Together with his associate, Daligastia, he came with the mission of leading primitive humankind from hunters to herdsmen and farmers and of developing culture and civilization.

The corporeal staff of one hundred: Of the more than 785,000 ascendant citizens of Jerusem, the system capital, who volunteered, one hundred (fifty men and fifty women) were chosen as Caligastia's staff.

Repersonalization and physical bodies: These one hundred received transplants of the life plasm extracted from one hundred superior descendants of Andon and Fonta (fifty men and fifty women), and in ten days they were repersonalized as superhuman beings possessing actual bodies of flesh and blood.

Diet and the maintenance of immortality: They ate only a vegetarian diet, and by partaking of the fruit of the "tree of life," brought from Edentia and planted in the central temple court, they did not age and maintained physical immortality.

2. The First World Capital, "Dalamatia"

Location and architecture: It was established in the region of the Persian Gulf (Mesopotamia) of that time and was called "Dalamatia" after the Prince's associate, Daligastia. It was surrounded by a wall forty feet high, and in it were ten residential districts and, in the very center of the city, the three-story "temple of the unseen Father."

The introduction of the seven-day week: The Dalamatia teachers divided the twenty-eight-day lunar month into four parts, introducing the seven-day week for the first time in the history of the earth and providing a day for spiritual worship.

The appearance of the primary midwayers: Through the nonsexual (morontia-soul) union of the men and women of the staff, a corps of 50,000 primary midway creatures, invisible to human eyes but helping in the administration of the planet, was born in this period.

3. The Systematic Uplift by the Ten Planetary Councils

The staff of one hundred formed ten autonomous councils of ten members each and developed human society in many directions.

The council on food and material welfare (chairman: Ang): Instruction in irrigation, well digging, the treatment of skins, and weaving.

The board of animal domestication (chairman: Bon): The taming of wild animals and the fostering of animal husbandry.

The advisers regarding the conquest of predatory animals: The building of defensive systems to protect people from ferocious beasts.

The faculty of dissemination and conservation of knowledge (chairman: Fad): The spreading of the alphabet, the system of knowledge, and writing.

The commission on industry and trade (chairman: Nod): The regulation of barter and the development of early industry.

The college of revealed religion (chairman: Hap): The replacement of fear (ghost worship) with the worship of God, and the promulgation of "the Father's prayer" and hymns of worship.

The board of health and sanitation (chairman: Lut): The introduction of a weekly cleansing bath and of the handshake as a sign of friendship.

The council on art and science (chairman: Mek): The rudiments of physics and chemistry, the making of pottery, and the elevation of aesthetic ideals.

The council on improved tribal government (chairman: Tut): The regulation of warfare and the promotion of peaceful federation among tribes.

The supreme court of racial co-ordination (chairman: Van): Serving as the supreme court mediating planet-wide matters and racial conflicts.

The policy of evolutionary acceleration: The one hundred held to a policy not of radical revelation or revolution but of naturally accelerating social evolution, gathering the superior young people of the surrounding tribes into the schools of Dalamatia, educating them, and sending them back as leaders.

4. The Tragic Interruption and the Submergence of Dalamatia

Three hundred thousand years of prosperity and the rebellion: The civilization of Dalamatia prospered peacefully for about 300,000 years, but about 200,000 years ago it met with great tragedy when the Planetary Prince Caligastia joined the rebellion of Lucifer, the System Sovereign.

The division of the staff: Of the staff of one hundred, forty, including Van, remained loyal, but sixty, including Nod, joined the rebellion. The loyal staff preserved the tree of life and ascended to Jerusem, whereas the sixty rebels lost the life circuits, were reduced to the status of material mortals, and later became the ancestors of the "Nodites."

The fall and submergence of Dalamatia: When Caligastia rashly proclaimed "unlimited liberty," society rapidly regressed into savagery, and 162 years after the rebellion broke out, a great tidal wave swept over Dalamatia, and the whole city sank beneath the sea

q109.question: What is meant by the eleven-and-a-half-year sunspot cycle and the three-and-a-half-day brightness cycle?
q109.answer:
1. The Three-and-a-Half-Day (3.5-Day) Brightness Cycle

The upheavals and pulsations of the early sun: In the early days when the sun was forming, continuous contraction and rising internal temperature produced enormous upheavals and convulsions on the solar surface.

The 3.5-day cycle: At that time the sun swelled and contracted like a giant breath, and it took exactly three and a half days (3.5 days) to complete one cycle of changing brightness.

2. The Eleven-and-a-Half-Year (11.5-Year) Sunspot Cycle

The lengthening and stabilization of the pulsation cycle: As the sun gradually cooled and entered a relatively stable state, the powerful upheavals and pulsation cycle of its youth gradually diminished and lengthened; the legacy of this is the present 11.5-year sunspot cycle.

Evidence of a history as a variable star: The 11.5-year sunspot cycle observed today is therefore an indicator showing that our sun was in the past a variable star that pulsated periodically.

3. Cosmic Significance (the Occasion of the Solar System's Formation)

Sensitivity to outside influences: The state of a variable star pulsating on a three-and-a-half-day cycle made the surface of the sun very sensitive to outside gravitational stimuli.

The birth of the solar system (Monmatia): When the enormous Angona system approached about 4.5 billion years ago, at the moments of maximum expansion (upheaval) in the sun's three-and-a-half-day pulsation, the sun was subjected to a powerful gravitational pull, and enormous quantities of solar material were ejected into space; this became the decisive occasion for the condensation of this material into the planets of the present solar system, including the earth.

q110.question: Please explain in detail the origin, dispersion, and influence of the Andites as described in The Urantia Book.
q110.answer:
The Andites described in The Urantia Book were the most versatile and powerful primary blended race, the people who led the civilization of the earth and the biologic uplift of mankind in the post-Adamic age [78:0.1, 78:4.3].

The origin of the Andites, their worldwide dispersion, and the influence they left on modern civilization and on mankind are as follows.

1. The Origin and Character of the Andites

Racial composition: The Andites were a blended race, born when the pure-line violet race (the Adamites), the direct descendants of Adam and Eve, first united with the Nodites, the descendants of the rebel staff of Dalamatia, and when the evolutionary peoples (the Sangik colored races and the Andonites) were then added to this union [78:4.1, 78:4.2].

Standard of classification: The Urantia Book classifies as "Andite" those peoples whose total racial inheritance contained from one-eighth to one-sixth (about 12.5% to 16.6%) or more of violet (Adamic) blood [78:4.1].

Place and time of origin: They began to form about 25,000 B.C. on the periphery of the second garden in Mesopotamia and in the region of the Adamsonite headquarters near the Kopet mountains, south of the Caspian Sea [78:1.3, 78:4.2].

Racial characteristics:

The high intellect, peaceful tradition, and creative imagination of the Adamites combined with the military skill, adventurousness, and technical ability of the Nodites, and the Andites are therefore regarded as the finest and most versatile human stock in the history told by The Urantia Book [78:4.3, 78:4.5].

The early Andites were not themselves white (Caucasoid) or Aryan, but they laid the common biologic and cultural foundation of the later white races of Europe and western Asia [78:4.4].

2. The Eastward Expansion of the Andites (Asia, India, China, the Pacific, South America)

Driven by a restless instinct for roving and exploration, the Andites spread through central Asia and on across the whole of the East [78:4.6, 79:1.1].

Turkestan and central Asia:

In the highlands of Turkestan east of the Caspian Sea, in Sinkiang (the Tarim basin), and in Tibet they established the eastern frontier of true Andite culture [79:1.1, 79:1.2].

In this region the Andonic dialect blended with the language of the Adamsonites and Andites, and so began the "Aryan mother tongue" of the peoples who later conquered Europe and India [78:5.3].

When the drying of the climate brought severe drought about 8000 B.C., they built the great commercial metropolis of Adonia near Ashkhabad and developed commerce and urban culture [79:1.3, 79:1.4].

India (the Dravidians and the Aryan invasion):

First invasion (about 15,000 B.C.): The Andites who entered the valleys of the Indus and Ganges by way of Baluchistan blended with the natives to form the Dravidian civilization, and they led in city building and in sea trade across the Arabian Sea with Sumeria [79:2.4, 79:3.1, 79:3.7].

Second invasion (about 2500 B.C.): Andite cavalrymen pushing down from central Asia reconquered India under the name of Aryans, transplanting the Caspian and Sethite priestly tradition and the foundations of the caste system [79:4.1, 79:4.5, 79:4.6].

China (the acceleration of the Yellow River civilization):

About 15,000 B.C. the Andites entered the upper Yellow River (Kansu and Honan) through the pass of Ti Tao and intermarried with the northern yellow people [79:7.1].

Stimulated by the Andites, and with their able minds so quickened, the northern Chinese brought the Yellow River civilization to a level superior to that of the southern settlements on the Yangtze [79:7.2, 79:7.3].

Pacific voyages and South America (the ancestors of the Inca rulers):

One hundred and thirty-two Andites set out by boat from Japan across the Pacific and, passing through the Polynesian islands (Easter Island and others), reached the Andes of South America [78:5.7]. By union with the natives they became the ancestors of the later Inca rulers [78:5.7].

3. The Westward Expansion of the Andites (Europe, Egypt, the Aegean)

The westward expansion of the Andites determined the physical and cultural landscape of the European races [80:1.8, 80:4.1].

The invasion of Europe and the formation of the white (Caucasoid) races:

By about 12,000 B.C. three quarters of the world's Andites were living in northern and eastern Europe, and they entered Europe in seven major waves of invasion [78:5.4, 80:4.1].
