Allowing freewill choice to mature: it was to give all creatures within Satania ample time for testing, without outside pressure or hasty suppression by force, so that they might clearly choose, of their own will, between truth and sin.

④ The Prospect of Lifting the Spiritual Quarantine

The arch-rebels of the Lucifer rebellion (Lucifer, Satan, and others) are now confined on the prison worlds of Jerusem.

On the day when the superuniverse courts of Orvonton (the Ancients of Days) hand down the final verdict in the case of "Gabriel vs. Lucifer" and the decree of the rebels' extinction, the spiritual circuits of the entire system of Satania will be fully restored, and the isolated planets, Urantia included, will return to the embrace of the universe family.

q142.question: What will the "era of light and life" look like that Urantia will enter after the system of Satania is restored to the normal circuits, and what is the role of the "Twenty-four Counselors" (the twenty-four elders)?
q142.answer:
The details concerning the era of light and life and the Twenty-four Counselors (the twenty-four elders) are as follows.

1. The Era of Light and Life

The era of light and life is the final and most glorious stage of evolutionary attainment reached by an evolutionary world that has passed through the trials of time and space. After the spiritual quarantine (isolation) caused by the Lucifer rebellion in the system of Satania is fully lifted and the circuits are restored, the glorious features and characteristics of this era through which Urantia will pass are as follows.

① Full Restoration of the Universe Circuits and Cosmic Integration

Restoration of universe broadcasts and communication: the isolated tertiary spirit circuits and the regular broadcast circuits of the local universe and the superuniverse are fully reopened.

Reunion with the great cosmic family: personal intercourse between planets and between systems becomes active, and Urantia is no longer a spiritual orphan of the universe but is fully integrated as an honored member of the whole family of the grand universe.

② The Change from Death to "Translation"

Direct morontia ascension from the life in the flesh: natural physical death is no longer a necessary and inevitable experience for mortals.

The experience of the chariot of fire: spiritually mature, advanced mortals, at the end of their lives, do not pass through the death of the body; in union with their indwelling Thought Adjusters they are translated directly into the morontia state in a "chariot of fire" (a flash of light) and ascend to the first mansion world.

③ The Social and Biological Summit and the Great Unification of Civilization

One language, one religion, one philosophy: all of Urantia is unified in one universal language, one spiritual religion worshiping the one God, and one mature philosophy of rounded harmony (mota).

Complete conquest of disease, degeneracy, and war: through racial improvement and the advance of medicine and biology, disease and mental defectiveness disappear completely, and war and the military machinery vanish into history.

Great lengthening of the life span: the average life span of mortals increases greatly, to from three hundred to five hundred years or more of Urantia time.

④ The Appearance of the Morontia Temple and the Finaliters' Participation in Administration

The settling of the morontia temple on earth: the Paradise finaliters, who have completed the Paradise-Havona ascension, and the Trinity Teacher Sons appear on earth, erect the morontia temple, associate personally with the mortals of earth, and counsel them in cosmic wisdom.

Elevation to Planetary Sovereign: by the decree of the Michael Son, the existing Planetary Prince is elevated to the status of Planetary Sovereign and rules in fatherly fashion over a world like a garden of light.

⑤ The Course of Seven Stages

The era of light and life expands through the following seven stages and moves toward the unification of the whole grand universe:

First (the planetary stage): the stage in which the morontia temple is established and the whole system is settled

Second (the system stage): the system capital and all the inhabited planets settled in light

Third (the constellation stage): the spiritual settling of the entire constellation

Fourth (the local universe stage): the settling of the local universe headquarters and the whole realm in light and life

Fifth (the minor sector stage), sixth (the major sector stage), and seventh (the superuniverse stage)

2. The "Twenty-four Counselors" (the Twenty-four Elders) Assigned to Urantia

The beings recorded in the Revelation of John in the New Testament as the "four and twenty elders" seated round about the throne of God (Revelation 4:4) are the principal members of the Urantia advisory council (the Jerusem advisory council) located on Jerusem, the capital of the system of Satania.

① Identity and the Background of Its Founding

Time of founding: about nineteen hundred years ago, soon after Christ Michael (Jesus) completed his mortal bestowal and resurrection on Urantia and established his full sovereignty over Nebadon, twenty-four seats were formally placed in the center of the angelic residential circles on Jerusem.

Required qualifications: all are outstanding mortals and creatures of Urantia (the earth) origin (with the exception of Machiventa Melchizedek), persons whose leadership was recognized as they passed through their earth lives, the mansion world experience, and citizenship training on Jerusem.

② Role and Authority

Personal representatives of Michael: on Jerusem, under the orders of Michael and Gabriel, they direct, on behalf of the Sovereign Son, the dispensational resurrections (roll calls), the mortal ascension plan, and administrative affairs of Urantia and the system of Satania.

Advisory supervision of the thirty-six isolated worlds of Satania: they serve as the advisory supervisory commission for all thirty-six planets in the system of Satania isolated by the Lucifer rebellion, and they frequently visit those planets.

Sending the resident governor general of Urantia: every hundred years they choose one of the Twenty-four Counselors and send him to earth as the resident governor general, residing directly on Urantia, to co-ordinate superhuman administration. (For example, John the Baptist is the chairman of the Jerusem council, and 1-2-3 the First, the first midwayer, has served as resident governor general.)

③ The Roster of the Twenty-four Counselors (Sixteen Permanent Members + Eight Seats Held in Reserve)

Of the twenty-four seats of the Urantia advisory council, sixteen are permanently filled by great spiritual leaders of Urantia's past, and eight are held in reserve for future ages.

No. 1, Onagar: the master mind of the age before the coming of the Planetary Prince, who led primitive men in the worship of "The Breath Giver."

No. 2, Mansant: the great teacher of the post-Planetary Prince age, who led his fellows in the veneration of "The Great Light."

No. 3, Onamonalonton: the spiritual leader of the red man (the Indians), who led his tribes in the worship of "The Great Spirit."

No. 4, Orlandof: a prince of the blue men, who first brought them to recognize the divinity of "The Supreme Chief."

No. 5, Porshunta: the oracle of the vanished orange race, who taught the worship of "The Great Teacher."

No. 6, Singlangton: the spiritual leader of the yellow men, who rejected polytheism and led them to worship "The One Truth" (God).

No. 7, Fantad: the deliverer of the green race, who led his tribes to the worship of "⟦Q 45:4.9⟧The One Source of Life⟦/Q⟧."

No. 8, Orvonon: the enlightener of the indigo races (the black races), who led them to serve "The God of Gods."

No. 9, Adam: the planetary father of Urantia (a Material Son), who repented after his default, was rehabilitated, and was received into this group.

No. 10, Eve: the mother of the violet race of Urantia (a Material Daughter), who was rehabilitated together with Adam and serves with him.

No. 11, Enoch: the first mortal of Urantia to fuse with the Thought Adjuster during the life in the flesh and ascend.

No. 12, Moses: the leader who emancipated a remnant of the violet race and revived the worship of "The God of Israel" (Yahweh).

No. 13, Elijah: a translated soul of brilliant spiritual achievement in the post-Material Son age.

No. 14, Machiventa Melchizedek: the Melchizedek who made an incarnated bestowal on earth as king of Salem in the days of Abraham; at present the vicegerent Planetary Prince of Urantia.

No. 15, John the Baptist: the forerunner of the earthly mission of Michael (Jesus); at present the chairman of the twenty-four-member advisory council on Jerusem.

No. 16, 1-2-3 the First: the heroic leader of the primary midway creatures who kept their loyalty on the side of Gabriel at the time of the Caligastia rebellion.

Nos. 17-20, open (temporarily filled): held in reserve for future ascending mortals who will come from the present Son age (the postbestowal age).

Nos. 21-24, open (temporarily filled): held in reserve for the teachers of the coming ages of the Magisterial Sons, the Teacher Sons, and light and life.

q143.question: How do the "twelve corps of the master seraphim of planetary supervision," which overcontrol Urantia's spiritual civilization, operate, and what is the role of the "reserve corps of destiny"?
q143.answer:
According to Paper 114 of The Urantia Book (Seraphic Planetary Government), even under the special circumstances of the Lucifer rebellion and planetary isolation, the spiritual civilization and administration of Urantia (the earth) are being precisely and systematically overcontrolled through the twelve corps of master seraphim and the reserve corps of destiny on earth.

1. The Twelve Corps of the Master Seraphim of Planetary Supervision and Their Techniques of Operation

When the first resident governor general arrived on Urantia at the time of Pentecost, he was accompanied by twelve special corps of seraphim, graduates of Seraphington, who carry on the planetary supervision of their respective fields under the focused direction of the resident governor general and under the leadership of the council of seraphic chiefs.

① The Specific List and Roles of the Twelve Corps

Epochal angels: the angels of the current dispensation, who direct the affairs of each generation so that they fit into the great mosaic pattern of their age.

Progress angels: they foster social and civilizational evolution and constantly awaken the inherent progressive trend of creatures.

Religious guardians: called the "⟦Q 114:6.7⟧angels of the churches⟦/Q⟧," they guard the safe transit of the imperishable moral and spiritual values held in old forms into the thought patterns of a new generation.

Angels of nation life: the "⟦Q 114:6.8⟧angels of the trumpets⟦/Q⟧," who overcontrol international relations and the political activities of nations, carrying out the principle that "the Most Highs rule in the kingdoms of men."

Angels of the races: they work for the conservation of the evolutionary races on earth, regardless of their political and religious entanglements, and co-operate with the race commissioners.

Angels of the future: the forecasting angels, who serve as architects designing in advance the better patterns and plans of the new age to come.

Angels of enlightenment: they foster intellectual and moral education and training at the level of the individual, the family, the school, the community, and the nation.

Angels of health: they assist the mortal agencies and institutions that labor for the promotion of health and the prevention of disease.

Home seraphim: they are devoted to the preservation and uplifting of the home, the basic institution of human civilization.

Angels of industry: they stimulate industrial development and improve economic conditions and the conditions of production.

Angels of diversion: they promote the values of wholesome play, humor, and rest and encourage the profitable use of leisure.

Angels of superhuman ministry: the "⟦Q 114:6.16⟧angels of the angels⟦/Q⟧," who minister to all other superhuman spiritual beings sojourning on or visiting the planet.

② The Specific Operating Techniques of the Master Seraphic Corps

Noncoercive influence: the master seraphim do not violate human free will or exercise arbitrary or coercive control.

Manipulation and association of the environment: they manipulate planetary conditions around the domains of voluntary human activity and associate circumstances so as to bring about, indirectly, a favorable influence on particular fields of civilization.

Strengthening ideals and focusing the mind: though they cannot directly inject new concepts into the human mind, they find the higher ideals and values already budding in the human intellect and make their light shine more brightly.

Activating the emergency safety net: against the danger of the collapse of civilization or the extinguishing of spiritual light, they mobilize and maintain the reserve corps of destiny, made up of mortals on earth.

2. The Secret Role of the Reserve Corps of Destiny

The reserve corps of destiny is an emergency liaison and ministry group made up of living men and women, chosen to support on earth the world plans carried forward by the superhuman administrators.

① Composition and Size

On Urantia there are twelve reserve corps of destiny, corresponding one to one to the twelve corps of master seraphim.

They consist of 962 mortals on earth in all (as of that time), who possess self-conscious Thought Adjusters and personal guardians of destiny.

② Conditions and Qualifications for Selection

Outstanding capacity of mind, able to rehearse secretly and unconsciously the special assignments prepared for planetary emergencies.

The will to devote oneself wholeheartedly to particular spiritual, social, or political purposes without human reward or outward recognition.

Moral character that possesses a versatile Thought Adjuster and has attained the higher levels of the cosmic and spiritual circles.

③ The Secret Training Techniques and the Role of the Secondary Midwayers

Unconscious rehearsal: apart from some twenty contact personalities, most members of the reserve corps are entirely unaware that they are an emergency reserve force.

Unconscious training during sleep: while the mortal is asleep or in deep states of mind, unconscious training and rehearsals for preserving information are carried on through the mediation of the indwelling Thought Adjuster, the seraphic guardian, and the secondary midway creatures. (The presentation of the Urantia revelatory papers through materialization in English was likewise made possible through this technique of Adjuster-midwayer-mortal mind contact.)

Transfer of information from Adjuster to Adjuster: when a member of the reserve corps finishes his earth life, the precious planetary emergency information is passed directly from the Adjuster of the dying personality to the Adjuster of a younger successor and so is preserved.

④ Central Mission and Cosmic Significance

A safety valve for evolutionary civilization: the foremost mission of the reserve corps is to prevent the collapse of evolutionary culture or the extinguishing of the light of spiritual truth amid social catastrophes or spiritual dark ages.

Ministry behind the front of history: in ordinary times they remain unseen, but when historic upheavals or emergencies of truth break out, they come forward as the decisive catalysts who bring about the rule of the Most Highs on earth.

q144.question: What is the "cosmic reserve corps," whose members expand their cosmic consciousness and commune with the celestial circuits, and what is the hundred-year administrative procedure of the resident governor general of Urantia?
q144.answer:
The key statements about the existence of the "cosmic reserve corps" and the hundred-year administrative procedure of the "resident governor general," described in Paper 114 of The Urantia Book (Seraphic Planetary Government), are as follows.

1. The Existence of the Cosmic Reserve Corps

Membership: on Urantia (the earth) there exists a "cosmic reserve corps" made up of more than one thousand mortals whose high insight into cosmic citizenship far transcends the limits of their terrestrial abode.

The secrecy of its function: this unique group of human beings expands its cosmic consciousness and communes with the celestial circuits, but according to the revelation, disclosing details about the real nature of its function and work is strictly forbidden.

The distinction from the "reserve corps of destiny":

Whereas the 962 members of the "reserve corps of destiny," who receive training during unconscious sleep to assist the superhuman ministry of the planet, serve as a working liaison network prepared for planetary emergencies, the "cosmic reserve corps" is clearly distinguished as a separate group of over a thousand mortals who possess cosmic insight.

2. The Hundred-Year Administrative Procedure of the Resident Governor General

① The Hundred-Year Term and the Procedure of Appointment

Designation by the Twenty-four Counselors: every one hundred years of Urantia time, the twenty-four planetary supervisors who make up the Jerusem advisory council (ascended mortals, all formerly of Urantia) designate one of their number and send him to Urantia as resident governor general.

Anonymity maintained: because mortals are so prone to venerate and even to deify superhuman leaders and extraordinary compatriots, the personal name of the current resident governor general is withheld from human beings on earth. (At the time the revelation was written, the twentieth resident governor general was serving.)

② Administrative Character and Role

Co-ordinator of superhuman administration: rather than exercising autocratic or arbitrary rule on earth, the resident governor general, acting on behalf of the Twenty-four Counselors, functions as the respected chief co-ordinating supervisor and leader of all the celestial beings working on Urantia (the seraphic hosts, the midway creatures, and others).

A fatherly adviser: he acts as a fatherly adviser rather than a formal ruler, and every day he renders final rulings and decisions on the many questions arising among spiritual beings such as the seraphim and the midwayers.

③ The Daily Consultation Conference

Every morning the supermaterial government of Urantia begins its day's work by holding a conference of consultation under the leadership of the resident governor general.

This daily conference is attended by the resident governor general, the planetary chief of archangels, the Most High observer from Edentia, the supervising supernaphim, the chief of the resident Life Carriers, and visiting high universe Sons, who co-ordinate the routine administrative affairs of the planet.

④ Administrative Direction Through the Cabinet of the Twelve Master Seraphim

The immediate administrative cabinet of the resident governor general is made up of the twelve acting chiefs of the twelve corps of master seraphim of planetary supervision (epochal, progress, religion, nation life, races, future, enlightenment, health, home, industry, diversion, and superhuman ministry), and through this council he overcontrols each field of planetary civilization.

⑤ His Role After the End of His Term

Having completed his hundred-year term, the resident governor general returns to Jerusem, the system capital, sits as a temporary member of the council of Planetary Princes under the System Sovereign of Satania, reports on the progress of Urantia's administration, and serves in an advisory capacity at the system level.
